senses.def: a small wooden part inside a piano, that hits the strings to produce a sound
a part inside a gun that makes the gun fire
a metal ball attached to a wire, thrown as a sport
the event or sport of throwing the hammer
if two people are at it hammer and tongs or go at it hammer and tongs, they argue or fight with a lot of energy and noise
to hit sth with a hammer

ex.en: I could hear somebody hammering next door.
ex.cn: 我听到隔壁有人在锤打东西。

ex.en: She hammered the nail into the wall.
ex.cn: 她把钉子钉到墙上。

ex.en: He was hammering the sheet of copper flat.
ex.cn: 他正把铜片锤平。

senses.def: to hit sth hard many times, especially so that it makes a loud noise
senses.chn: 反复敲打，连续击打（尤指发出大声）

ex.en: Someone was hammering at the door.
ex.cn: 有人在砰砰地打门。

ex.en: Hail was hammering down onto the roof.
ex.cn: 冰雹砸得屋顶咚咚响。

ex.en: I was so scared my heart was hammering (= beating very fast) in my chest.
ex.cn: 我吓得心怦怦直跳。

ex.en: He hammered the door with his fists.
ex.cn: 他不断地用拳头擂门。

ex.en: Someone was beating at the door.
ex.cn: 有人在打门。

ex.en: A young man was found beaten to death last night.
ex.cn: 昨天夜里有人发现一名小伙子被打死了。

senses.def: to kick or hit a ball very hard

ex.en: He hammered the ball into the net.
ex.cn: 他一记猛射，将球踢进网。

senses.def: to defeat sb very easily

ex.en: Our team was hammered 5–1.
ex.cn: 我队以 1:5 的悬殊比分败北。

senses.def: to work hard in order to finish or achieve sth; to keep repeating sth in order to get the result that you want
to emphasize a point, an idea, etc. so that people fully understand it
senses.chn: 反复讲透，重点讲清（要点、想法等）

senses.def: to kick a ball hard and score a goal
senses.chn: 用力踢球得分；把球猛踢进球门

senses.def: to make sb learn or remember sth by repeating it many times
to discuss a plan, an idea, etc. until everyone agrees or a decision is made
senses.chn: 反复讨论出（一致意见）；充分研讨出（决定）

ex.en: to hammer out a compromise
ex.cn: 反复讨论达成妥协

senses.def: to play a tune, especially on a piano, loudly and not very well

example.en: She hammered the nail into the wall.
example.cn: 她把钉子钉到墙上。

example.en: He was hammering the sheet of copper flat.
example.cn: 他正把铜片锤平。

example.en: He hammered the door with his fists.
example.cn: 他不断地用拳头擂门。

senses.def: tools representing the people who work in industry and farming, used on the flag of the former Soviet Union and as a symbol of Communism
senses.chn: 锤子和镰刀（代表工人和农民，苏联国旗用以象征共产主义）

senses.def: if two people are at it hammer and tongs or go at it hammer and tongs, they argue or fight with a lot of energy and noise
to work hard in order to finish or achieve sth; to keep repeating sth in order to get the result that you want
a drill that makes holes in stone or bricks by making very fast hitting movements as it turns
very drunk
a shark with flat parts sticking out from either side of its head with eyes at the ends
the sound of sb hitting sth with a hammer or with their fists
senses.chn: （锤子或拳头的）敲打声，捶打声

ex.en: the sound of hammering from the next room
ex.cn: 隔壁传来的敲打声

senses.def: an act of defeating or criticizing sb severely

ex.en: Our team took a real hammering in the first half.
ex.cn: 上半场我队吃了个大败仗。

senses.def: a way of holding sb so that their arm is bent behind their back and they cannot move
senses.chn: 锁臂（将对手手臂扭到背后并压制住）

senses.def: to discuss a plan, an idea, etc. until everyone agrees or a decision is made
senses.chn: 反复讨论出（一致意见）；充分研讨出（决定）

ex.en: to hammer out a compromise
ex.cn: 反复讨论达成妥协

senses.def: to play a tune, especially on a piano, loudly and not very well
the last and highest amount offered for sth at an auction which is the price for which it is sold
to make sb learn or remember sth by repeating it many times
a type of bed made from a net or from a piece of strong material, with ropes at each end that are used to hang it between two trees, posts, etc.
artificial or exaggerated
to prevent sb from easily doing or achieving sth
a large basket with a lid, especially one used to carry food in
senses.chn: （尤指用于盛食物的）带盖大篮子

ex.en: a picnic hamper
ex.cn: 野餐篮

senses.def: a box or package containing food, sent as a gift
senses.chn: （作为礼品的）盒装食物，袋装食物

ex.en: a Christmas hamper
ex.cn: 圣诞礼品盒

senses.def: a large basket that you keep your dirty clothes in until they are washed
an animal like a large mouse, with large cheeks for storing food. Hamsters are often kept as pets.
senses.chn: 仓鼠（有颊囊可存放食物，常作宠物）

senses.def: one of the five tendons behind the knee that connect the muscles of the upper leg to the bones of the lower leg

ex.en: a hamstring injury
ex.cn: 腘绳肌腱受伤

ex.en: She's pulled a hamstring.
ex.cn: 她拉伤了一条腘绳肌腱。

senses.def: a tendon behind the middle joint (= hock ) of the back leg of a horse and some other animals
senses.chn: （马等跗关节后部的）后腿肌腱，大肌腱

senses.def: to prevent sb/sth from working or taking action in the way that is needed
senses.chn: 妨碍；使不能正常工作（或行动）

senses.def: the part of the body at the end of the arm, including the fingers and thumb

ex.en: Ian placed a hand on her shoulder.
ex.cn: 伊恩把一只手搭在她的肩上。

ex.en: Put your hand up if you know the answer.
ex.cn: 知道答案就举手。

ex.en: Keep both hands on the steering wheel at all times.
ex.cn: 双手要始终握住方向盘。

ex.en: She was on (her) hands and knees (= crawling on the floor) looking for an earring.
ex.cn: 她正趴在地板上到处寻找耳环。

ex.en: Couples strolled past holding hands.
ex.cn: 一对对恋人手拉手漫步经过。

ex.en: Give me your hand (= hold my hand) while we cross the road.
ex.cn: 过马路时拉着我的手。

senses.def: using the hand or number of hands mentioned

ex.en: a one-handed catch
ex.cn: 单手抓接

ex.en: left-handed scissors (= intended to be held in your left hand)
ex.cn: 供左手使用的剪刀

senses.def: help in doing sth

ex.en: Let me give you a hand with those bags (= help you to carry them).
ex.cn: 我来帮你拎那些包吧。

ex.en: Do you need a hand with those invoices?
ex.cn: 要不要我帮你处理那些发票？

ex.en: The neighbours are always willing to lend a hand.
ex.cn: 邻居们总是乐于帮忙。

senses.def: the part or role that sb/sth plays in a particular situation; sb's influence in a situation

ex.en: Early reports suggest the hand of rebel forces in the bombings.
ex.cn: 早期的报道暗示叛乱武装插手了爆炸案。

ex.en: Several of his colleagues had a hand in his downfall.
ex.cn: 他的几个同事促使了他下台。

ex.en: This appointment was an attempt to strengthen her hand in policy discussions.
ex.cn: 这次任命旨在加强她在政策讨论中的作用。

senses.def: a part of a clock or watch that points to the numbers
a person who does physical work on a farm or in a factory
senses.chn: （农场或工厂的）体力劳动者，工人

senses.def: a sailor on a ship

ex.en: All hands on deck!
ex.cn: 全体船员到甲板上集合！

senses.def: by a person rather than a machine

ex.en: hand-painted pottery
ex.cn: 手绘陶器

ex.en: hand-knitted
ex.cn: 手工编织的

ex.en: This item should be hand washed.
ex.cn: 这件物品要用手洗。

senses.def: a set of playing cards given to one player in a game

ex.en: to be dealt a good/bad hand
ex.cn: 拿到一手好牌／烂牌

senses.def: one stage of a game of cards

ex.en: I'll have to leave after this hand.
ex.cn: 这一盘打完后我必须走了。

senses.def: a particular style of writing
a unit for measuring the height of a horse, equal to 4 inches or 10.16 centimetres
senses.chn: 一手之宽（测量马的高度的单位，等于 4 英寸或 10.16 厘米）

senses.def: everyone helps or must help, especially in a difficult situation

ex.en: There are 30 people coming to dinner tonight, so it's all hands on deck.
ex.cn: 今天晚上有 30 人来吃饭，要全体动员了。

senses.def: close to you in time or distance

ex.en: Help was at hand.
ex.cn: 援助近在咫尺。

ex.en: The property is ideally located with all local amenities close at hand.
ex.cn: 这处房地产的位置很理想，离当地的生活设施都近。

senses.def: if you experience sth at the hands of sb, they are the cause of it
senses.chn: 某人导致；出自某人之手

senses.def: to be skilful at making or doing things with your hands
to tie sb's hands and feet together so that they cannot move or escape
to prevent sb from doing what they want by creating rules, restrictions, etc.
by a person rather than a machine

ex.en: The fabric was painted by hand.
ex.cn: 这个织品是手染的。

senses.def: if a letter is delivered by hand, it is delivered by the person who wrote it, or sb who is sent by them, rather than by post/mail
to become controlled by sb
senses.chn: 受制于某人；被某人控制

ex.en: The town fell into enemy hands.
ex.cn: 那个小镇落入敌人手里了。

ex.en: We don't want this document falling into the wrong hands.
ex.cn: 我们不希望这份文件落入不当的人手中。

senses.def: by experiencing, seeing, etc. sth yourself rather than being told about it by sb else

ex.en: The President visited the area to see the devastation at first hand.
ex.cn: 总统亲临该地区视察受损情况。

senses.def: to do physical work

ex.en: He's not frightened of getting his hands dirty.
ex.cn: 他不怕体力劳动。

senses.def: permission to marry sb, especially a woman

ex.en: He asked the general for his daughter's hand in marriage.
ex.cn: 他请求将军把女儿许配给他。

senses.def: working closely with sb, especially in a secret and/or illegal way
senses.chn: 同某人密切合作（尤指勾结）

senses.def: if two people are hand in hand, they are holding each other's hand
if two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and one thing causes the other

ex.en: Poverty and poor health often go hand in hand.
ex.cn: 贫困和健康不良常有连带关系。

senses.def: easily and without any doubt
senses.chn: 容易地；易如反掌地；毋庸置疑地

ex.en: They won hands down.
ex.cn: 他们轻松取胜。

ex.en: It is hands down the best movie this year.
ex.cn: 这无疑是今年最好的电影。

senses.def: used to tell sb not to touch sth/sb

ex.en: Get your hands off my wife!
ex.cn: 不许碰我妻子！

ex.en: Hey, hands off! That's my drink!
ex.cn: 嘿，别动！那是我的饮料！

senses.def: used to tell a group of people to raise one hand in the air if they know the answer to a question, etc.

ex.en: Hands up all those who want to go swimming.
ex.cn: 想去游泳的人举手。

senses.def: used by sb who is threatening people with a gun to tell them to raise both hands in the air
to be very busy or too busy to do sth else
senses.chn: 忙得不可开交；应接不暇

ex.en: She certainly has her hands full with four kids in the house.
ex.cn: 家里养着四个孩子，她当然忙得团团转。

senses.def: to be unable to do what you want to do because of rules, promises, etc.

ex.en: I really wish I could help but my hands are tied.
ex.cn: 我的确想帮忙，但却多有不便。

senses.def: to give sb support in a difficult situation
senses.chn: （困难时）给某人支持；拉某人一把

ex.en: Do you want me to come along and hold your hand?
ex.cn: 你想让我过去帮你一把吗？

senses.def: to admit that you have made a mistake or are responsible for sth bad
senses.chn: 承认犯错；承认对坏事负有责任

ex.en: I have to hold my hands up and admit that some of the problems have been all my own fault.
ex.cn: 我必须承认有些问题完全是我自己的错。

senses.def: being taken care of or dealt with by sb that you think you can rely on
senses.chn: 由可信任的人负责（或处理等）

ex.en: Can I leave these queries in your capable hands?
ex.cn: 我能否请你这个能手来解答这些疑问？

senses.def: if you have time or money in hand, it is left and available to be used
if you have a particular situation in hand, you are in control of it
the job, question, etc. in hand is the one that you are dealing with
if sb works a week, month, etc. in hand, they are paid for the work a week, etc. after they have completed it
being taken care of or controlled by sb
senses.chn: 受某人照料；受某人控制

ex.en: The matter is now in the hands of my lawyer.
ex.cn: 这件事现在正由我的律师处理。

ex.en: At that time, the castle was in enemy hands.
ex.cn: 那时城堡在敌人手中。

senses.def: to occasionally do sth that you used to do a lot so that you do not lose your skill at it
senses.chn: 偶尔操练某事以保持熟练

ex.en: She retired last year but still teaches the odd class to keep her hand in.
ex.cn: 她去年退休了，但偶尔还上课，以免技巧生疏。

senses.def: to catch sb that you are annoyed with

ex.en: Wait till I get my hands on him!
ex.cn: 等我抓住他再说！

senses.def: to find or get sth

ex.en: I know their address is here somewhere, but I can't lay my hands on it right now.
ex.cn: 我知道他们的地址就放在这块儿，但我一时找不到。

senses.def: used to say that a job is made easier if a lot of people help
senses.chn: 人多好办事；众人拾柴火焰高

senses.def: to do no work

ex.en: She hasn't done a hand's turn all week.
ex.cn: 她闲了整整一星期。

senses.def: no longer your responsibility
on both/all sides; in both/all directions
senses.chn: 在双方面／各个方面；在两个／各个方向

senses.def: available, especially to help

ex.en: The emergency services were on hand with medical advice.
ex.cn: 随时都有急诊服务，并提供医疗咨询。

senses.def: if you have sb/sth on your hands, you are responsible for them or it

ex.en: Let me take care of the invitations—you've enough on your hands with the caterers.
ex.cn: 让我来负责发邀请吧，你负责洽办酒席就够忙了。

senses.def: used to introduce different points of view, ideas, etc., especially when they are opposites
senses.chn: （引出不同的，尤指对立的观点、思想等）一方面…，另一方面…

ex.en: On the one hand they'd love to have kids, but on the other, they don't want to give up their freedom.
ex.cn: 一方面，他们想要孩子，但另一方面，他们又不想放弃自由自在的生活。

ex.en: This survey highlights a number of differences in the way that teenage boys and girls in the UK spend their free time.
ex.cn: 这项民意测验凸显出英国十几岁的男孩和女孩在打发闲暇时间上的诸多不同。

ex.en: One of the main differences between the girls and the boys who took part in the research was the way in which they use the Internet.
ex.cn: 参与了这项研究的女生和男生之间的主要差异之一在于他们使用互联网的方式。

ex.en: Unlike the girls, who use the Internet mainly to keep in touch with friends, the boys questioned in this survey tend to use the Internet for playing computer games.
ex.cn: 女生使用互联网主要是和朋友联系，这一点和男生不同，参与调查的男生往往是使用互联网来玩电脑游戏。

ex.en: The girls differ from the boys in that they tend to spend more time keeping in touch with friends on the telephone or on social networking websites.
ex.cn: 与男生不同的是，女生往往花更多的时间通过电话或社交网站与朋友保持联系。

ex.en: Compared to the boys, the girls spend much more time chatting to friends on the telephone.
ex.cn: 与男生相比，女生花在与朋友电话聊天上的时间要多得多。

senses.def: difficult or impossible to control

ex.en: Unemployment is getting out of hand.
ex.cn: 失业问题越来越难以控制。

senses.def: if you reject, etc. sth out of hand, you do so immediately without thinking about it fully or listening to other people's arguments

ex.en: All our suggestions were dismissed out of hand.
ex.cn: 我们的建议均遭到了草率的拒绝。

senses.def: no longer your responsibility

ex.en: I'm afraid the matter is now out of my hands.
ex.cn: 恐怕这件事现已不归我管。

senses.def: to do exactly what an enemy, opponent, etc. wants so that they gain the advantage in a particular situation
senses.chn: 干敌人（或对手等）所希望的事；做有利于敌人（或对手等）的事；授人以可乘之机

ex.en: If we get the police involved, we'll be playing right into the protesters' hands.
ex.cn: 如果出动警察，那将正中抗议者的下怀。

senses.def: to spend money or give it to sb

ex.en: I've heard he doesn't like putting his hand in his pocket.
ex.cn: 我听说他手很紧。

senses.def: by being told about sth by sb else who has seen it or heard about it, not by experiencing, seeing, etc. it yourself
senses.chn: 经过二手三手地；间接地；非亲身经历

ex.en: I'm fed up of hearing about these decisions third hand!
ex.cn: 得从别人那里听说这些决定，我受够了！

senses.def: to deal with sb in a strict way in order to improve their behaviour
to deal with a particular situation yourself because you are not happy with the way that others are dealing with it
to stop doing sth or taking part in sth, especially because you are not successful
that you can reach or get easily

ex.en: I'm afraid I don't have the latest figures to hand.
ex.cn: 恐怕我手头没有最新的数据。

senses.def: to start doing sth or be able to do sth, especially when you do it well
senses.chn: （尤指成功、顺利地）着手做，能够做

ex.en: Jim can turn his hand to most jobs around the house.
ex.cn: 吉姆能担当起家里的大部分杂活。

senses.def: to show your approval of sb by clapping your hands; to be applauded in this way

ex.en: Ladies and gentlemen, let's give a big hand to our special guests tonight.
ex.cn: 女士们、先生们，让我们以热烈的掌声欢迎今晚的特邀嘉宾。

senses.def: it is better to keep sth that you already have than to risk losing it by trying to get much more
senses.chn: 一鸟在手胜过双鸟在林（满足于现有的总比因过分追求而失去一切好）

senses.def: to harm sb who has helped you or supported you
to be responsible for sb's death
senses.chn: 对某人的死亡罪责难逃

ex.en: a dictator with the blood of thousands on his hands
ex.cn: 手上沾满千万人鲜血的独裁者

senses.def: to ask sb for sth, especially money, in a very polite way that makes you seem less important
senses.chn: 谦卑地要，恭敬地讨（尤指钱）

senses.def: if you pay for goods and services cash in hand, you pay in cash, especially so that the person being paid can avoid paying tax on the amount
senses.chn: 现金支付（尤指受款人可避税）

senses.def: to pass to a different owner

ex.en: The house has changed hands several times.
ex.cn: 这房子已几易其主。

senses.def: near; in a place where sb/sth can be reached easily
senses.chn: 在附近；在触手可及的地方

ex.en: There are good cafes and a restaurant close at hand.
ex.cn: 附近有几家挺不错的咖啡馆和一家餐馆。

senses.def: to make yourself do sth that you are afraid of
senses.chn: 鼓起勇气（做自己害怕做的事）；敢作敢为

ex.en: Taking her courage in both hands, she opened the door and walked in.
ex.cn: 她壮着胆打开门，走了进去。

senses.def: an influence that controls or restricts sth
senses.chn: （控制或阻碍事物发展的）影响

ex.en: We need to free business from the dead hand of bureaucracy.
ex.cn: 我们必须摆脱官僚主义对工作的严重影响。

senses.def: people who do not have enough to do often start to do wrong

ex.en: She blamed the crimes on the local jobless teenagers. 'The devil makes work for idle hands,' she would say.
ex.cn: 她认为那些违法活动是当地的无业青少年所为，总是说：“人一闲，惹麻烦。”

senses.def: to trust sb and be willing to do what they say
senses.chn: 甘愿听命于某人；顺从某人

ex.en: She'll have them eating out of her hand in no time.
ex.cn: 她很快就会让他们俯首帖耳的。

senses.def: strong control or discipline
senses.chn: 牢固控制；严格纪律；铁腕

ex.en: Those children need a firm hand to make them behave.
ex.cn: 那些孩子得严加管教。

senses.def: to bring or hold your hands together

ex.en: She kept her hands folded in her lap.
ex.cn: 她双手合拢，放在腿上。

senses.def: to make sb do sth that they do not want to do or make them do it sooner than they had intended
senses.chn: 迫使某人做某事（或提前行动）

senses.def: to get, have, etc. the opportunity to do what you want to do and to make your own decisions
senses.chn: 可以全权处理；有自主权

ex.en: I was given a free hand in designing the syllabus.
ex.cn: 我获准全权制订教学大纲。

senses.def: to ask sb for sth, especially money, in a very polite way that makes you seem less important
senses.chn: 谦卑地要，恭敬地讨（尤指钱）

senses.def: a way of doing sth or of treating people that is much stronger and less sensitive than it needs to be
senses.chn: 严厉手段；粗暴方式；暴虐方式

ex.en: the heavy hand of management
ex.cn: 粗暴的管理方式

senses.def: to help sb
if you use the words an iron fist/hand when describing the way that sb behaves, you mean that they treat people severely. This treatment may be hidden behind a kind appearance (the velvet glove).
if two people join hands, they hold each other's hands
to work together in doing sth

ex.en: Education has been reluctant to join hands with business.
ex.cn: 教育界一向不肯与商界联手。

senses.def: to be very familiar with sb/sth

ex.en: This is where I grew up. I know this area like the back of my hand.

ex.cn: 你真的没有干吧？你不是在哄我吧？

senses.def: to be wearing sth

ex.en: She had a red jacket on.
ex.cn: 她穿着件红夹克。

ex.en: He had nothing (= no clothes) on.
ex.cn: 他没穿衣服。

senses.def: to leave a piece of equipment working

ex.en: She has her TV on all day.
ex.cn: 她一整天都开着电视机。

senses.def: to have arranged to do sth

ex.en: I can't see you this week—I've got a lot on.
ex.cn: 我这个星期不能见你，我安排得很满。

senses.def: to know sth bad about sb, especially sth that connects them with a crime
senses.chn: 有某人的把柄，掌握某人的证据（尤指与犯罪有关的）

ex.en: I'm not worried—they've got nothing on me.
ex.cn: 我不担心，他们没抓住我什么把柄。

senses.def: to cause sth, especially a part of your body, to be removed

ex.en: I had to have my appendix out.
ex.cn: 我只好把盲肠切除了。

senses.def: to try to settle a disagreement by discussing or arguing about it openly
senses.chn: （与某人）辩论出个结果，把某事讲个明白

ex.en: I need to have it out with her once and for all.
ex.cn: 我有必要跟她公开彻底地把话说清楚。

senses.def: to cause sb to be accused of sth in court

ex.en: He was had up for manslaughter.
ex.cn: 他因误杀罪被送上法庭。

senses.def: used with the past participle to form perfect tenses
senses.chn: （与过去分词连用构成完成时）

ex.en: I've finished my work.
ex.cn: 我干完我的活儿了。

ex.en: He's gone home, hasn't he?
ex.cn: 他回家去了，对吗？

ex.en: 'Have you seen it?' 'Yes, I have/No, I haven't.'
ex.cn: “你看见了吗？” “是的，看见了／没有，没看见。”

ex.en: She'll have had the results by now.
ex.cn: 她现在应该知道结果了。

ex.en: Had they left before you got there?
ex.cn: 你到那里时他们已经离开了吗？

ex.en: If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes I wouldn't have believed it.
ex.cn: 要不是亲眼看见了，我不会相信的。

example.en: He's got a front tooth missing.
example.cn: 他有一颗门牙掉了。

example.en: I must go—I have a bus to catch.
example.cn: 我必须走了，我得去赶公共汽车。

example.en: He had the bouncers throw them out of the club.
example.cn: 他叫保安人员把他们轰出了俱乐部。

example.en: She's always having the builders in to do something or other.
example.cn: 她总是让建筑工人到家里来干这干那。

example.en: We can't have people arriving late all the time.
example.cn: 我们不能允许有人总是迟到。

example.en: I want to have everything ready in good time.
example.cn: 我要求一切都得准时备妥。

senses.def: to enjoy yourself a lot
to be bad at keeping secrets
to talk too much, especially about your own abilities and achievements

have a bone to pick with sb.lemma: have a bone to pick with sb

senses.def: to be angry with sb about sth and want to discuss it with them
senses.chn: 对某人生气，想与之解决；有理由反对（或恼恨）某人

have a bun in the oven.lemma: have a bun in the oven

senses.def: to be pregnant

have a card up your sleeve.lemma: have a card up your sleeve

senses.def: to have an idea, a plan, etc. that will give you an advantage in a particular situation and that you keep secret until it is needed
to have the right to demand time, attention, etc. from sb
to become very angry or anxious about sth

ex.en: Don't have a cow—it's no big deal.
ex.cn: 别发火，没什么大不了。

senses.def: to have an understanding of sth or be naturally good at doing it
senses.chn: 善于理解某事物；有…的天才

ex.en: She has a real feel for languages.
ex.cn: 她有语言天才。

senses.def: to be given the opportunity to do sth that you enjoy, especially sth that other people do not approve of
senses.chn: 有展现本领的机会，有机会大干一番（尤指他人不赞同的事）

ex.en: The tabloid press had a field day with the latest government scandal.
ex.cn: 这家小报利用最近的政府丑闻大做文章。

have a finger in every pie.lemma: have a finger in every pie

senses.def: to be involved in a lot of different activities and have influence over them, especially when other people think that this is annoying
to attack sb physically

ex.en: There were about seven of them standing round him, all waiting to have a go.
ex.cn: 他们大约有七个人把他围起来，个个都等着下手。

senses.def: to criticize sb or complain about sb

ex.en: The boss had a go at me for being late for work.
ex.cn: 我上班迟到，老板剋了我一顿。

have a good head on your shoulders.lemma: have a good head on your shoulders

senses.def: to be a sensible person

have a good mind to do sth.lemma: have a good mind to do sth

senses.def: used to say that you think you will do sth, although you are not sure
senses.chn: 想去做某事，可能会做某事（但不确定）

ex.en: I've half a mind to come with you tomorrow.
ex.cn: 明天我可能会和你一起去。

senses.def: used to say that you disapprove of what sb has done and should do sth about it, although you probably will not
senses.chn: （表明有心做某事，但未必采取行动）

ex.en: I've a good mind to write and tell your parents about it.
ex.cn: 我真想写信给你父母，告诉他们这件事。

senses.def: to be good at sth

ex.en: to have a head for figures/business
ex.cn: 长于算术；有生意头脑

senses.def: if sb does not have a head for heights, they feel nervous and think they are going to fall when they look down from a high place
to be a very kind person
senses.chn: 有金子般的心；心肠很好

senses.def: to be a person who does not show others sympathy or pity
to enjoy yourself very much

have a long way to go.lemma: have a long way to go

senses.def: to need to make a lot of progress before you can achieve sth
senses.chn: 还有很长的路要走；还有很大差距

ex.en: She still has a long way to go before she's fully fit.
ex.cn: 她还需要很长时间才能完全恢复健康。

senses.def: to talk too much, especially about things that are private

have a mind of your own.lemma: have a mind of your own

senses.def: to have your own opinion and make your own decisions without being influenced by other people

ex.en: She has a mind of her own and isn't afraid to say what she thinks.
ex.cn: 她有主见，并且敢于表达自己的观点。

ex.en: My computer seems to have a mind of its own!
ex.cn: 我的电脑好像也有它自己的想法！

senses.def: to have private reasons for being involved in sth or for arguing for a particular cause

ex.en: She had no axe to grind and was only acting out of concern for their safety.
ex.cn: 她毫无私心，这样做只是出于对他们安全的担忧。

senses.def: to be able to judge if things look attractive, valuable, etc.
senses.chn: 对…有鉴赏力（或识别力、眼力）

ex.en: I've never had much of an eye for fashion.
ex.cn: 我对时装从来没多少鉴赏力。

ex.en: She has an eye for a bargain.
ex.cn: 她善识便宜货。

have a night on the tiles.lemma: have a night on the tiles

senses.def: to stay out late enjoying yourself
to have influence with sb
to look around a place; to look for sth in a place
to be very excited or impatient about sth and unable to stay still
to look carefully around a place to see what you can find; to try to find out information about sb/sth
to disagree with or object to sth

ex.en: I have no problem with you working at home tomorrow.
ex.cn: 你明天在家里工作，我没有意见。

ex.en: We are going to do this my way. Do you have a problem with that? (= showing that you are impatient with the person that you are speaking to)
ex.cn: 这件事将按照我的方法来做，你有什么意见吗？

have a roof over your head.lemma: have a roof over your head

senses.def: to have somewhere to live
to always be looking for the chance to have a new sexual relationship
senses.chn: 总是找机会寻花问柳；眼神不安分

senses.def: to be slightly strange in your behaviour
senses.chn: 举止略有异常；行为稍嫌古怪

senses.def: to be able to see or do unpleasant things without feeling sick or upset
to like food that contains a lot of sugar

have a way of doing sth.lemma: have a way of doing sth

senses.def: used to say that sth often happens in a particular way, especially when it is out of your control
senses.chn: …是常有的事（尤指无法控制的事）

ex.en: First love affairs have a way of not working out.
ex.cn: 第一次恋爱常常不成功。

have a whale of a time.lemma: have a whale of a time

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much; to have a very good time
senses.chn: 玩得很痛快；过得非常快活

have a word in sb's ear.lemma: have a word in sb's ear

senses.def: to speak to sb privately about sth
to have gained knowledge and experience of the world
to have been injured in a fight or an accident
senses.chn: 打架受伤；在事故中受伤

ex.en: You look like you've been in the wars—who gave you that black eye?
ex.cn: 看样子你打架受伤了，是谁把你打得鼻青眼肿？

senses.def: to know all about a situation because you have experienced it
to have made a lot of progress
senses.chn: 取得大的进步；大有长进

ex.en: We've come a long way since the early days of the project.
ex.cn: 这项目开始以来我们已取得很大进展。

senses.def: to be accepted or used by most people and therefore a permanent part of our lives
senses.chn: 为多数人所接受；得到普遍认可

ex.en: It looks like televised trials are here to stay.
ex.cn: 看来电视直播审判成了一种风气。

senses.def: to want to start a sexual relationship with sb
senses.chn: 企图占有某人；存心与某人发生性关系；对…存心不良

senses.def: to be planning to get sth for yourself, often in a way that other people do not approve of
senses.chn: 企图将某物据为己有；图谋得到某物；打…的鬼主意

ex.en: Rumours spread that the Duke had designs on the crown (= wanted to make himself king).
ex.cn: 谣传公爵觊觎王位。

senses.def: to do sth unpleasant as quickly as possible, so that it is finished
senses.chn: 赶快了结，尽快做完（令人不愉快的事）

ex.en: Why not tell her you're quitting and have done with it?
ex.cn: 为什么不告诉她你打算辞职，尽快把这件事了结呢？

senses.def: to finish sth unpleasant so that it does not continue

ex.en: Let's have done with this silly argument.
ex.cn: 我们结束这场无聊的争辩吧。

have eyes in the back of your head.lemma: have eyes in the back of your head

senses.def: to be aware of everything that is happening around you, even things that seem difficult or impossible to see
senses.chn: 脑后长眼；眼光敏锐；什么都能觉察到

senses.def: to have a fault or weakness in your character
to know important people who can help you
senses.chn: 有位高权重的朋友；有贵人相助

senses.def: to be very much in love

ex.en: You're not seeing him again tonight, are you? That's five times this week—you've got it bad!
ex.cn: 你今天晚上不再和他见面了，是吧？这个星期都约会了五次，你们热恋了！

have got sb under your skin.lemma: have got sb under your skin

senses.def: to be extremely attracted to sb
senses.chn: 极其迷恋；被某人深深打动

senses.def: to have had enough alcohol to make you drunk
to be in a very bad condition; to be unable to be repaired

ex.en: The car had had it.
ex.cn: 这辆车无法修复了。

senses.def: to be extremely tired

ex.en: I've had it! I'm going to bed.
ex.cn: 我太困了！我要去睡觉了。

senses.def: to have lost all chance of surviving sth

ex.en: When the truck smashed into me, I thought I'd had it.
ex.cn: 那辆卡车撞上我时，我想这下完了。

senses.def: to be going to experience sth unpleasant

ex.en: Dad saw you scratch the car—you've had it now!
ex.cn: 爸爸看见你把车身划了，这下可有你好受的了！

senses.def: to be unable to accept a situation any longer

ex.en: I've had it (up to here) with him —he's done it once too often.
ex.cn: 我受够他了，他这一次太过分了。

senses.def: to be slightly drunk
to be in a situation in which you are certain to be defeated or killed
to no longer be successful, powerful, etc.
senses.chn: 得意之时已过；风光不再；日渐衰败

ex.en: She's had her day as a supermodel.
ex.cn: 她作为超级模特儿的辉煌日子已一去不复返。

have half a mind to do sth.lemma: have half a mind to do sth

senses.def: used to say that you think you will do sth, although you are not sure
senses.chn: 想去做某事，可能会做某事（但不确定）

ex.en: I've half a mind to come with you tomorrow.
ex.cn: 明天我可能会和你一起去。

senses.def: used to say that you disapprove of what sb has done and should do sth about it, although you probably will not
senses.chn: （表明有心做某事，但未必采取行动）

ex.en: I've a good mind to write and tell your parents about it.
ex.cn: 我真想写信给你父母，告诉他们这件事。

senses.def: to be extremely upset and angry

ex.en: My mum'll have hysterics when she sees the colour of my hair.
ex.cn: 我妈妈看到我的头发的颜色会火冒三丈的。

senses.def: to not like sb and be unpleasant to them

have it in mind to do sth.lemma: have it in mind to do sth

senses.def: to intend to do sth
to be very anxious, angry or upset about sth
if you say that a news story, etc. has legs, you mean that people will continue to be interested in it for a long time
senses.chn: （新闻报道等）会长期受到关注

senses.def: to have so much money that you do not have to be careful with it
senses.chn: 钱多得花不完；有用不完的钱

senses.def: a place that is safe and peaceful where people or animals are protected
senses.chn: 安全的地方；保护区；避难所

ex.en: The hotel is a haven of peace and tranquility.
ex.cn: 这家旅馆是一处安宁的去处。

ex.en: The river banks are a haven for wildlife.
ex.cn: 河的两岸是野生动物的自然栖息地。

senses.def: to be able to remain calm in a difficult or dangerous situation
to be very lucky in dangerous situations
to have no right to do sth

ex.en: You have no business being here.
ex.cn: 你无权待在这里。

have no business to do sth.lemma: have no business to do sth

senses.def: to have no right to do sth

ex.en: You have no business being here.
ex.cn: 你无权待在这里。

senses.def: to be better than anything else or anyone else of the same type

ex.en: He is a player without equal.
ex.cn: 他是个无与伦比的运动员。

senses.def: used to emphasize that you do not know sth

ex.en: 'What's she talking about?' 'I've no idea.'
ex.cn: “她在讲什么？” “我一点也不了解。”

ex.en: He hasn't the faintest idea how to manage people.
ex.cn: 他根本不懂得人事管理。

senses.def: to not want to eat sth

ex.en: She had no stomach for the leftover stew.
ex.cn: 她不想吃剩下的炖菜。

senses.def: to not have the desire or courage to do sth
senses.chn: 没有做某事的欲望（或勇气）

ex.en: They had no stomach for a fight.
ex.cn: 他们不想打架。

senses.def: to have much less of a particular quality than sb/sth
senses.chn: 远比不上某人；比某人差得多

ex.en: I'm quite a fast worker, but I've got nothing on her!
ex.cn: 我做事已经很麻利了，但比她还差得远。

senses.def: to have no information that could show sb to be guilty of sth
to dislike sb

ex.en: I've no use for people who don't make an effort.
ex.cn: 我厌恶那些不努力的人。

senses.def: to not need sth
have not

have one foot in the grave.lemma: have one foot in the grave

senses.def: to be so old or ill/sick that you are not likely to live much longer
senses.chn: 行将就木；命不久矣；大去之期不远

senses.def: to remember and think carefully about sth

ex.en: It is always necessary to have regard to the terms of the contract.
ex.cn: 记住合同条款总是必要的。

senses.def: a bag that is carried on the back or over the shoulder, especially when walking in the country
senses.chn: （尤指野外步行背的）背包，褡裢

have sb in the palm of your hand.lemma: have sb in the palm of your hand

senses.def: to have complete control or influence over sb
senses.chn: 完全控制某人；把某人攥在手心里

senses.def: to have influence or power over sb, for example, a police officer or a politician, especially by threatening them or by offering them money
senses.chn: 驾驭，让…听使唤（尤指通过恐吓或贿赂）

senses.def: to try to make sb believe sth that is not true, usually as a joke
senses.chn: 哄骗，欺骗（通常作为玩笑）

ex.en: You didn't really, did you? You're not having me on, are you?
ex.cn: 你真的没有干吧？你不是在哄我吧？

have sb's blood on your hands.lemma: have sb's blood on your hands

senses.def: to be responsible for sb's death
senses.chn: 对某人的死亡罪责难逃

ex.en: a dictator with the blood of thousands on his hands
ex.cn: 手上沾满千万人鲜血的独裁者

senses.def: to be able to give sb advice, influence them, etc. because they trust you
senses.chn: 在某人那里说得上话；使某人听得进去

ex.en: He had the ear of the monarch.
ex.cn: 他在君主那里说得上话。

senses.def: to be very angry with sb and punish them severely for sth they have done
to want sb to be happy and successful even though your actions may not show this
senses.chn: 关心…的幸福成功；暗暗地替…着想

senses.def: to change your opinion after thinking about sth again
senses.chn: （经考虑后）改变想法；（转念一想）改变主意

senses.def: to have used all your power, money or supplies
to have the information, knowledge, etc. that is needed in a particular situation and be able to find it easily and use it quickly
senses.chn: 掌握（信息等）；熟悉，精通（知识等）；对…了如指掌；有…随时可供使用

senses.def: to receive sth that sb has borrowed or taken from you
senses.chn: 收回被借走（或拿走）的东西

ex.en: You can have your files back after we've checked them.
ex.cn: 我们核对完你的文件之后就还给你。

have sth coming out of your ears.lemma: have sth coming out of your ears

senses.def: to have a lot of sth, especially more than you need
senses.chn: 有的是某物（形容大量拥有，甚至超过所需）

senses.def: to be certain to win sth
to be able to believe sth because you trust the person who gave you the information
to think about sth all the time, especially in a way that is annoying
senses.chn: 某事萦绕心头；过分热衷

ex.en: He has sex on the brain.
ex.cn: 他脑子里想的全是性。

senses.def: to be in the middle of an activity or a project

ex.en: The award-winning novelist often has three or four books on the go at once.
ex.cn: 那位获奖小说家经常是三四部小说同时写的。

senses.def: to have sth as an advantage that will make it more likely that you will achieve sth
to cause sth, especially a part of your body, to be removed

ex.en: I had to have my appendix out.
ex.cn: 我只好把盲肠切除了。

senses.def: to have sth available that sb wants

ex.en: Oxford has a lot to offer visitors in the way of entertainment.
ex.cn: 牛津向来访者提供各式各样的娱乐活动。

ex.en: a young man with a great deal to offer (= who is intelligent, has many skills, etc.)
ex.cn: 一个多才多艺的年轻人

senses.def: to have achieved sth

ex.en: He's only 30, and he already has four novels to his credit.
ex.cn: 他年仅 30，却已著有四部小说。

senses.def: to have already achieved or obtained sth

ex.en: She already has a couple of good wins under her belt.
ex.cn: 她已大胜两场。

senses.def: to be likely to steal sth
senses.chn: 好偷东西的；有顺手牵羊的毛病

senses.def: to be powerful and effective
senses.chn: 具有强大威力；有杀伤力

have the courtesy to do sth.lemma: have the courtesy to do sth

senses.def: to know when you should do sth in order to be polite
senses.chn: 知道何时该做…（以示礼貌）

ex.en: You think he'd at least have the courtesy to call to say he'd be late.
ex.cn: 谁都会觉得他至少应该懂得打个电话说一声他要晚来。

senses.def: to be able to give sb advice, influence them, etc. because they trust you
senses.chn: 在某人那里说得上话；使某人听得进去

ex.en: He had the ear of the monarch.
ex.cn: 他在君主那里说得上话。

have the face to do sth.lemma: have the face to do sth

senses.def: to do sth that other people think is rude or shows a lack of respect, without feeling embarrassed or ashamed
senses.chn: 居然有脸干某事；恬不知耻做某事

senses.def: to be successful when you were not expected to be, making your opponents look stupid
senses.chn: （在本未指望时）笑在最后，取得最后胜利

senses.def: to have the qualities that are necessary to become sth
senses.chn: 具备了成为…的必要条件

ex.en: Her first novel has all the makings of a classic.
ex.cn: 她的第一部小说堪称经典之作。

senses.def: to feel hungry
to have found a very good or successful way of living, doing sth, etc.
senses.chn: 找到好的（或成功的）方式；找对路

ex.en: He's certainly got the right idea—retiring at 55.
ex.cn: 他真的想通了，打算在 55 岁时退休。

have the time of your life.lemma: have the time of your life

senses.def: to enjoy yourself very much

have the world at your feet.lemma: have the world at your feet

senses.def: to be very successful and admired
to have nothing to do or not be busy
senses.chn: 无所事事；没事可干；闲着

senses.def: to have nothing to do or not be busy
senses.chn: 无所事事；没事可干；闲着

senses.def: used to show that you must do sth

ex.en: Sorry, I've got to go.
ex.cn: 对不起，我必须走了。

ex.en: Did she have to pay a fine?
ex.cn: 她非得交罚款吗？

ex.en: You don't have to knock—just walk in.
ex.cn: 不必敲门，进来就是了。

ex.cn: 看到故居被照管得这么好，真叫人高兴。

senses.def: to act according to what you feel rather than to what you think is sensible
to stop hoping for sth or trying to do sth because you no longer feel confident
to fall in love with sb/sth
a man/woman who likes the same things or has the same opinions as you
senses.chn: 趣味相投者；情投意合者

senses.def: used to say that you do not feel sympathy or pity for sb

ex.en: 'I have to go to Brazil on business.' 'My heart bleeds for you!'
ex.cn: “我要出差去巴西。” “真够可怜的！”

senses.def: to be unable to do sth because you know that it will make sb sad or upset
to tell sb all your problems, feelings, etc.
senses.chn: 向某人敞开心扉；倾诉衷肠

senses.def: to want sth very much
to feel more positive about sth, especially when you thought that you had no chance of achieving sth
senses.chn: （由于某事）增强信心；重新振作起来

ex.en: The government can take heart from the latest opinion polls.
ex.cn: 政府可以从最近的民意测验中找回信心。

senses.def: to be very upset by sth that sb says or does
senses.chn: 对某事感到烦恼；十分介意（某人的话或行为）；耿耿于怀

senses.def: to destroy the most important part or aspect of sth
as much as you want

ex.en: a supervised play area where children can run around to their heart's content
ex.cn: 一处能让孩子们尽情游玩且有人看管的地方

senses.def: completely

ex.en: I hope with all my heart that things work out for you.
ex.cn: 我衷心希望你一切顺利。

senses.def: used to say that when you are away from sb that you love, you love them even more
if you have a change of heart, your attitude towards sth changes, usually making you feel more friendly, helpful, etc.
senses.chn: 改变态度，改变看法（通常指变得更友好、有益等）

senses.def: used to emphasize that you are telling the truth or will do what you promise

ex.en: I saw him do it—cross my heart.
ex.cn: 我看见是他干的，我可以发誓。

senses.def: used to compare two things and say that one of them is better

ex.en: Look at him dance! Eat your heart out, Fred Astaire (= he dances even better than Fred Astaire).
ex.cn: 看看他跳的舞！比弗雷德 · 阿斯泰尔跳得还好。

senses.def: if sth is etched on your memory, you remember it because it has made a strong impression on you
senses.chn: 铭记在心；永志不忘；牢记心头

senses.def: if a person does not know about sth that they would normally disapprove of, then it cannot hurt them
senses.chn: 眼不见（心不烦）；眼不见为净

ex.en: What does it matter if I use his flat while he's away? What the eye doesn't see…!
ex.cn: 我趁他外出时用他的公寓有什么关系呢？反正他又看不见！

senses.def: to be able or willing to do sth

ex.en: Can you find it in your heart to forgive her?
ex.cn: 你能够做到宽恕她吗？

ex.en: He couldn't find it in himself to trust anyone again.
ex.cn: 他再也不愿意相信任何人了。

senses.def: from feelings of kindness, without thinking about what advantage there will be for you
senses.chn: 出于好心（不从中捞取好处）

ex.en: You're not telling me he offered to lend you the money out of the goodness of his heart?
ex.cn: 你该不是说他是纯粹出于好心才主动借钱给你的吧？

senses.def: a home is where the people you love are
to want sb to be happy and successful even though your actions may not show this
senses.chn: 关心…的幸福成功；暗暗地替…着想

senses.def: very unhappy or disappointed
to cry noisily for a long time because you are very sad
senses.chn: 悲切地哭泣；很伤心地哭泣

senses.def: to make sb fall in love with you
to make sb be afraid, etc.
to strongly affect you in an emotional way
senses.chn: 使伤心；使心如刀绞；使愁肠寸断

senses.def: to make sb feel happy or sympathetic
senses.chn: 使人内心感到高兴（或同情）

senses.def: the way to make sb like or love you
senses.chn: 赢得某人喜爱的办法；攻心策

ex.en: The way to a man's heart is through his stomach (= by giving him good food).
ex.cn: 取得男人欢心的方法就是让他吃好。

senses.def: to allow your feelings to be seen by other people
senses.chn: 让感情外露；把心事挂在脸上

senses.def: to make sb love you
thinking and behaving like a young person even when you are old
a strong feeling of sadness or worry

ex.en: The relationship caused her a great deal of heartache.
ex.cn: 这段恋情使她非常伤心。

ex.en: the heartaches of being a parent
ex.cn: 为人父母的烦恼

senses.def: with a lot of energy and enthusiasm
senses.chn: 满腔热忱干劲十足；全心全意

ex.en: They threw themselves heart and soul into the project.
ex.cn: 他们全心全意地投入了这个项目。

senses.def: a sudden serious medical condition in which the heart stops working normally, sometimes causing death
the movement or sound of the heart as it sends blood around the body

ex.en: a rapid/regular heartbeat
ex.cn: 急速／正常的心跳

senses.def: an important feature of sth, that is responsible for making it what it is

ex.en: The candidate said that he understood the heartbeat of the Hispanic community in California.
ex.cn: 这位候选人说他了解加利福尼亚州的拉美裔美国人社区的特点。

senses.def: very close to sth
very quickly, without thinking about it

ex.en: If I was offered another job, I'd leave in a heartbeat.
ex.cn: 如果能找到另外一份工作，我马上就走。

senses.def: a strong feeling of sadness

ex.en: They suffered the heartbreak of losing a child through cancer.
ex.cn: 他们因癌症夺去了一个孩子而肝肠寸断。

senses.def: extremely sad because of sth that has happened
a pain that feels like sth burning in your chest caused by indigestion
senses.chn: （消化不良引起的）胃灼热，烧心

senses.def: to give sb encouragement or hope
a serious medical condition in which the heart does not work correctly
showing strong feelings that are sincere

ex.en: a heartfelt apology/plea/sigh
ex.cn: 真切的道歉／恳求／叹息

ex.en: heartfelt sympathy/thanks
ex.cn: 由衷的同情／感谢

senses.def: the floor at the bottom of a fireplace (= the space for a fire in the wall of a room); the area in front of this
senses.chn: 壁炉炉床；壁炉前的地面

ex.en: A log fire roared in the open hearth.
ex.cn: 柴火在敞开着的壁炉里熊熊燃烧。

ex.en: The cat dozed in its favourite spot on the hearth.
ex.cn: 猫躺在壁炉前它最喜欢的地方打盹。

senses.def: home and family life

ex.en: a longing for hearth and home
ex.cn: 对温暖家庭的渴望

senses.def: a rug placed on the floor in front of a fireplace (= a small carpet) placed on the floor in front of a fireplace
with obvious enjoyment and enthusiasm
senses.chn: 尽情地；关怀地；劲头十足地

ex.en: to laugh/sing/eat heartily
ex.cn: 开怀大笑；放声歌唱；大吃

senses.def: in a way that shows that you feel strongly about sth

ex.en: I heartily agree with her on this.
ex.cn: 在这一点上我十分赞同她。

senses.def: extremely

ex.en: heartily glad/relieved
ex.cn: 极为高兴；愁云尽扫

senses.def: the central part of a country or an area
senses.chn: （国家或地区的）腹地，中心区域

ex.en: the great Russian heartlands
ex.cn: 广袤的俄罗斯中心地带

senses.def: an area that is important for a particular activity or political party
senses.chn: （活动或政党的）重要场所，核心区域

ex.en: the industrial heartland of Germany
ex.cn: 德国的工业中心区

ex.en: the traditional Tory heartland of Britain's boardrooms
ex.cn: 保守党的传统领地：英国的各董事会

senses.def: feeling no pity for other people

ex.en: What a heartless thing to say!
ex.cn: 这么说话太无情了！

senses.def: a machine that replaces the functions of the heart and lungs, for example during a medical operation on the heart
senses.chn: 心肺机（手术等时发挥心肺功能）

senses.def: causing feelings of great sadness

ex.en: a heart-rending story
ex.cn: 令人心痛的故事

senses.def: the process of examining carefully your feelings or reasons for doing sth
extremely unhappy or disappointed
causing feelings of great excitement or worry
senses.chn: 使人非常兴奋的；令人十分担忧的

ex.en: For one heart-stopping moment she thought they were too late.
ex.cn: 一时间她十分担心他们已经太晚了。

senses.def: strong feelings of love or pity

ex.en: to tug/pull at sb's heartstrings (= to cause such feelings in sb)
ex.cn: 动人心弦

senses.def: (used especially in newspapers) a famous man, usually an actor or a singer, that a lot of women find attractive
senses.chn: （尤用于报章，常指男性演员或歌手）万人迷，大众情人

senses.def: a conversation in which two people talk honestly about their feelings and personal problems

ex.en: to have a heart-to-heart with sb
ex.cn: 和某人谈心

senses.def: causing feelings of happiness and pleasure
the hard older inner layers of the wood of a tree
showing friendly feelings for sb

ex.en: a hearty welcome
ex.cn: 热情的欢迎

senses.def: loud, cheerful and full of energy
senses.chn: 喧闹而活泼的；吵闹快活且精力充沛的

ex.en: a hearty and boisterous fellow
ex.cn: 活泼爱吵闹的家伙

ex.en: a hearty voice
ex.cn: 响亮的嗓子

senses.def: large; making you feel full

ex.en: a hearty breakfast
ex.cn: 丰盛的早餐

ex.en: to have a hearty appetite
ex.cn: 胃口极好

senses.def: showing that you feel strongly about sth

ex.en: He nodded his head in hearty agreement.
ex.cn: 他十分赞同地点了点头。

ex.en: Hearty congratulations to everyone involved.
ex.cn: 谨向所有有关人员表示热烈的祝贺。

ex.en: a hearty dislike of sth
ex.cn: 对某事物的强烈反感

senses.def: strong and healthy
a person who is loud, cheerful and full of energy, especially one who plays a lot of sport
senses.chn: 喧闹、快活而且精力充沛的人（尤指好体育运动的人）

senses.def: the quality of being hot

ex.en: He could feel the heat of the sun on his back.
ex.cn: 他感觉到太阳照射在背上的热力。

ex.en: Heat rises.
ex.cn: 热空气向上升。

ex.en: The fire gave out a fierce heat.
ex.cn: 火焰散发出炽热。

senses.def: the level of temperature

ex.en: to increase/reduce the heat
ex.cn: 提高／降低温度

ex.en: Test the heat of the water before getting in.
ex.cn: 入水之前先试一试水温。

ex.en: Set the oven to a low/high/moderate heat.
ex.cn: 把烤箱的温度设定为低／高／中挡。

senses.def: hot weather; the hot conditions in a building/vehicle, etc.
senses.chn: 炎热天气；（建筑物、车辆等中的）高温，热的环境

ex.en: You should not go out in the heat of the day (= at the hottest time).
ex.cn: 你不应该在天最热的时候外出。

ex.en: to suffer from the heat
ex.cn: 受暑热之苦

ex.en: the afternoon/midday heat
ex.cn: 午后／正午时分的热浪

ex.en: The heat in the factory was unbearable.
ex.cn: 工厂里的高温令人无法忍受。

senses.def: a source of heat, especially one that you cook food on

ex.en: Return the pan to the heat and stir.
ex.cn: 把锅放回灶上再搅拌。

senses.def: strong feelings, especially of anger or excitement
senses.chn: 强烈感情；（尤指）愤怒，激动

ex.en: 'No, I won't,' he said with heat in his voice.
ex.cn: “不，我绝不。” 他怒气冲冲地说。

ex.en: The chairman tried to take the heat out of the situation (= to make people calmer).
ex.cn: 主席尽力平息人们的激愤情绪。

ex.en: In the heat of the moment she forgot what she wanted to say (= because she was so angry or excited).
ex.cn: 她因为过于激动而忘记了要说的话。

ex.en: In the heat of the argument he said a lot of things he regretted later.
ex.cn: 他在激烈争吵时说了许多他后来感到后悔的话。

senses.def: pressure on sb to do or achieve sth

ex.en: The heat is on now that the election is only a week away.
ex.cn: 离选举只有一个星期了，因此大家开始感觉到有压力了。

ex.en: United turned up the heat on their opponents with a second goal.
ex.cn: 联队进了第二个球，这使对手感到的压力更大了。

ex.en: Can she take the heat of this level of competition?
ex.cn: 她承受得了这种水平的比赛的压力吗？

senses.def: one of a series of races or competitions, the winners of which then compete against each other in the next part of the competition

ex.en: a qualifying heat
ex.cn: 资格赛

ex.en: She won her heat.
ex.cn: 她在预赛中获胜。

ex.en: He did well in the heats; hopefully he'll do as well in the final.
ex.cn: 他在预赛中成绩很好，且有望在决赛中也有同样出色的表现。

senses.def: to be in a sexual condition ready to reproduce
used to tell sb to stop trying to do sth if they find it too difficult, especially in order to suggest that they are less able than other people
senses.chn: 如果感到太困难（就别干了）

senses.def: to make sth hot or warm; to become hot or warm

ex.en: Heat the oil and add the onions.
ex.cn: 把油烧热后加入洋葱。

ex.en: The system produced enough energy to heat several thousand homes.
ex.cn: 系统产生的能量足以给几千户人家供暖。

senses.def: to become hot or warm

ex.en: The oven takes a while to heat up.
ex.cn: 烤箱得过会儿才能热起来。

senses.def: to become more exciting or to show an increase in activity

ex.en: The election contest is heating up.
ex.cn: 选举竞争正趋于白热化。

senses.def: to make sth hot or warm

ex.en: Just heat up the food in the microwave.
ex.cn: 把食物放在微波炉里热热就行了。

senses.def: full of anger and excitement
senses.chn: 愤怒的；激烈的；十分激动的

ex.en: a heated argument/debate
ex.cn: 激烈的争论／辩论

ex.en: She became very heated.
ex.cn: 她不禁怒火中烧。

senses.def: made warmer using a heater

ex.en: a heated swimming pool
ex.cn: 温水游泳池

senses.def: a machine used for making air or water warmer

ex.en: a gas heater
ex.cn: 煤气炉

ex.en: a water heater
ex.cn: 热水器

senses.def: a device for making heat pass from one liquid to another without allowing the liquids to mix
senses.chn: 热交换器，换热器（使热从热流体传递给冷流体）

senses.chn: （杂草和灌木丛生的）荒地，荒野

used to refer to a person who shows lack of education
senses.chn: 未开化的人；不文明的人

senses.def: connected with heathens
senses.chn: 无宗教信仰的；异教徒的；不文明的

ex.en: heathen gods
ex.cn: 异教的神祇

ex.en: He set out to convert the heathen (= people who are heathens).
ex.cn: 他决心要使异教徒皈依。

senses.def: a low wild plant with small purple, pink or white flowers, that grows on hills and areas of wild open land (= moorland )
senses.chn: 帚石楠（低矮野生，开紫、粉红或白色小花）

senses.def: a large area of heath
having a very complicated design, especially when used to perform a very simple task; not practical
senses.chn: 结构过于复杂的；不实用的

ex.en: a Heath Robinson contraption
ex.cn: 复杂而不实用的装置

senses.def: the process of supplying heat to a room or building; a system used to do this
senses.chn: 供暖；供暖系统；暖气设备

ex.en: Who turned the heating off?
ex.cn: 谁把暖气关掉了？

ex.en: What type of heating do you have?
ex.cn: 你们用什么供暖？

ex.en: a gas heating system
ex.cn: 燃气供暖系统

ex.en: heating bills
ex.cn: 暖气账单

senses.def: that cannot be damaged by heat
senses.chn: 隔热的；抗热的；耐高温的

ex.en: a heatproof dish
ex.cn: 耐高温的盘子

senses.def: not easily damaged by heat
that moves towards the heat coming from the aircraft, etc. that it is intended to hit and destroy
senses.chn: 热自导引的；跟踪热源的

ex.en: heat-seeking missiles
ex.cn: 热自导引导弹

senses.def: an illness with fever and often loss of consciousness, caused by being in too great a heat for too long
to become hot or warm

ex.en: The oven takes a while to heat up.
ex.cn: 烤箱得过会儿才能热起来。

senses.def: to become more exciting or to show an increase in activity

ex.en: The election contest is heating up.
ex.cn: 选举竞争正趋于白热化。

senses.def: a period of unusually hot weather

ex.cn: 我用力把箱子弄下楼梯。

ex.en: They heaved the body overboard.
ex.cn: 他们使劲把尸体从船上抛入水中。

ex.en: We all heaved on the rope.
ex.cn: 我们大家一起用力拉绳子。

senses.def: to rise up and down with strong, regular movements

ex.en: The boat heaved beneath them.
ex.cn: 小船在他们脚下颠簸着。

ex.en: Her shoulders heaved with laughter.
ex.cn: 她笑得双肩抖动。

senses.def: to make a sound slowly and often with effort

ex.en: We all heaved a sigh of relief.
ex.cn: 我们都如释重负地舒了一口气。

ex.en: The thought of it makes me heave.
ex.cn: 一想到那事我就恶心。

senses.def: to appear, especially when moving gradually closer from a long way off

ex.en: A ship hove into sight.
ex.cn: 远处出现了一条船。

an act of lifting, pulling or throwing

ex.en: With a mighty heave he lifted the sack onto the truck.
ex.cn: 他用劲一举，把大麻袋扔到卡车上。

senses.def: a rising and falling movement

ex.en: the steady heave of the sea
ex.cn: 大海汹涌不断的波涛

example.en: I managed to heave the trunk down the stairs.
example.cn: 我用力把箱子弄下楼梯。

example.en: We all heaved on the rope.
example.cn: 我们大家一起用力拉绳子。

example.en: Her shoulders heaved with laughter.
example.cn: 她笑得双肩抖动。

senses.def: to dismiss sb from their job; to end a relationship with sb
senses.chn: 解雇某人；同某人断绝关系

senses.def: the place believed to be the home of God where good people go when they die

ex.en: the kingdom of heaven
ex.cn: 天国

ex.en: I feel like I've died and gone to heaven.
ex.cn: 我仿佛觉得自己已经死了，进了天堂。

ex.en: This isn't exactly my idea of heaven!
ex.cn: 这可不太像我所想象的那么美妙！

ex.en: It was heaven being away from the office for a week.
ex.cn: 一个星期远离办公室真是快活极了。

ex.en: The island is truly a heaven on earth.
ex.cn: 那个岛堪称人间天堂。

senses.def: the sky

ex.en: Four tall trees stretched up to the heavens.
ex.cn: 四棵大树参天而立。

senses.def: used to show that you are surprised or annoyed
senses.chn: （表示惊奇或气恼）天哪，我的天

ex.en: Good heavens, what are you doing?
ex.cn: 天哪，你在干什么？

senses.def: it began to rain heavily
seeming to be perfect
used to say that you hope that sth will not happen

ex.en: 'Maybe you'll end up as a lawyer, like me.' 'God forbid!'
ex.cn: “也许你会像我一样，最终成为律师。” “但愿不会这样！”

senses.chn: （惊讶、震惊或烦恼时说）天哪，啊哟，主啊

ex.en: God, what a stupid thing to do!
ex.cn: 天啊，这事干得太蠢了！

senses.chn: （用于动词之后，强调希望、愿望等）的确，真

ex.en: I wish to God you'd learn to pay attention!
ex.cn: 我真希望你能学会集中注意力！

senses.def: used to say that you are afraid sb will be in danger or that sth bad will happen to them
senses.chn: （表示担心某人将有危险或有难）

ex.cn: 如果这个行不通，那就要靠上帝了。

senses.def: to have a strong unpleasant smell
senses.chn: 发出难闻气味；难闻透顶

senses.def: to seem to be very dishonest or morally unacceptable
used to emphasize that you do not know sth

ex.en: God knows what else they might find.
ex.cn: 谁知道他们还可能找到什么。

ex.en: 'Where are they?' 'Goodness knows.'
ex.cn: “他们在哪儿？” “天晓得。”

senses.chn: （强调所言属实）老天作证，确实，的确

ex.cn: 她应该考试合格，她已经够努力了。

senses.def: to do everything you possibly can in order to achieve sth
used especially in questions to show that you are angry, surprised or shocked
senses.chn: （尤用于疑问句，表示愤怒、惊奇或震惊）看在上帝的分上，到底，究竟

ex.en: What in God's name was that noise?

ex.en: I held the mouse by its tail.
ex.cn: 我抓着耗子的尾巴倒提起来。

ex.en: The girl held her father's hand tightly.
ex.cn: 女孩紧紧地拉着她父亲的手。

ex.en: He was holding the baby in his arms.
ex.cn: 他抱着婴儿。

ex.en: The winning captain held the trophy in the air.
ex.cn: 获胜队的队长把奖杯高举到空中。

ex.en: We were holding hands (= holding each other's hands).
ex.cn: 我们手拉着手。

senses.def: to put your hand on part of your body, usually because it hurts
senses.chn: 抱住，捂住，按住（受伤的身体部位等）

ex.en: She groaned and held her head.
ex.cn: 她呻吟着，用手抱住头。

senses.def: to keep sb/sth in a particular position

ex.en: Hold your head up.
ex.cn: 抬起头来。

ex.en: Hold this position for a count of 10.
ex.cn: 保持这个姿势别动，数到 10。

ex.en: The wood is held in position by a clamp.
ex.cn: 这木头用夹钳固定住了。

ex.en: I had to hold my stomach in (= pull the muscles flat) to zip up my jeans.
ex.cn: 我得把肚皮收紧才能拉上牛仔裤的拉链。

ex.en: I'll hold the door open for you.
ex.cn: 我会把门给你开着的。

senses.def: to support the weight of sb/sth

ex.en: I don't think that branch will hold your weight.
ex.cn: 我觉得那根树枝撑不住你的重量。

senses.def: to have enough space for sth/sb; to contain sth/sb

ex.en: This barrel holds 25 litres.
ex.cn: 这只桶能盛 25 升。

ex.en: The plane holds about 300 passengers.
ex.cn: 这架飞机可容纳大约 300 名乘客。

senses.def: to keep sb and not allow them to leave

ex.en: Police are holding two men in connection with last Thursday's bank raid.
ex.cn: 警方拘留了两名与上星期四的银行抢劫案有关的男子。

ex.en: He was held prisoner for two years.
ex.cn: 他被囚禁了两年。

senses.def: to defend sth against attack; to have control of sth

ex.en: The rebels held the radio station.
ex.cn: 叛乱者占据了电台。

senses.def: to remain strong and safe or in position
senses.chn: 承受住；坚持住；保持原位

ex.en: They were afraid the dam wouldn't hold.
ex.cn: 他们担心大坝会承受不住。

senses.def: to remain the same

ex.en: How long will the fine weather hold?
ex.cn: 好天气会持续多久？

ex.en: If their luck holds, they could still win the championship.
ex.cn: 如果他们的好运持续下去，他们仍能赢得冠军。

senses.def: to keep sb's attention or interest
senses.chn: 使（注意力或兴趣）持续不减；吸引住

ex.en: There wasn't much in the museum to hold my attention.
ex.cn: 博物馆中没有很多让我感兴趣的东西。

senses.def: to keep sth at the same level, rate, speed, etc.
senses.chn: 使保持同样程度（或比率、速度等）

ex.en: Hold your speed at 70.
ex.cn: 把速度保持在 70。

senses.def: to keep sth so that it can be used later

ex.en: records held on computer
ex.cn: 存在计算机中的记录

ex.en: Our solicitor holds our wills.
ex.cn: 律师保存着我们的遗嘱。

ex.en: We can hold your reservation for three days.
ex.cn: 您的预订我们可以保留三天。

senses.def: to own or have sth

ex.en: Employees hold 30% of the shares.
ex.cn: 雇员持有 30% 的股份。

senses.def: to have a particular job or position

ex.en: How long has he held office?
ex.cn: 他任职有多久了？

senses.def: to have sth you have gained or achieved

ex.en: Who holds the world record for the long jump?
ex.cn: 跳远世界纪录的保持者是谁？

ex.en: She held the title of world champion for three years.
ex.cn: 她保持了三年的世界冠军头衔。

senses.def: to have a belief or an opinion about sb/sth

ex.en: He holds strange views on education.
ex.cn: 他对教育的看法不同寻常。

ex.en: She is held in high regard by her students (= they have a high opinion of her).
ex.cn: 学生对她评价很高。

ex.en: firmly-held beliefs
ex.cn: 坚定的信念

senses.def: to consider that sth is true

ex.en: I still hold that the government's economic policies are mistaken.
ex.cn: 我仍然认为政府的经济政策是错误的。

ex.en: Parents will be held responsible for their children's behaviour.
ex.cn: 父母将要对孩子的行为负责。

ex.en: These vases are held to be the finest examples of Greek art.
ex.cn: 这些花瓶被视为希腊艺术的最佳典范。

senses.def: to have a meeting, competition, conversation, etc.

ex.en: The meeting will be held in the community centre.
ex.cn: 会议将在社区活动中心举行。

ex.en: It's impossible to hold a conversation with all this noise.
ex.cn: 噪音这么大，根本没法进行交谈。

senses.def: to be in close contact with the road and easy to control, especially when driven fast
to continue to move in a particular direction
to make a note continue for a particular time
to wait until you can speak to the person you have telephoned

ex.en: That extension is busy right now. Can you hold?
ex.cn: 分机现在占线。您能等一会吗？

ex.en: She asked me to hold the line.
ex.cn: 她要我别挂断电话。

senses.def: used to tell sb to stop doing sth or not to do sth

ex.en: Hold your fire! (= don't shoot)
ex.cn: 别开枪！

ex.en: Hold the front page! (= don't print it until a particular piece of news is available)
ex.cn: 把头版暂时空着！

ex.en: Give me a hot dog, but hold the (= don't give me any) mustard.
ex.cn: 给我来份热狗，但别加芥末。

senses.def: to be true

ex.en: The same argument does not hold good in every case.
ex.cn: 同样的论点并非在所有的情况下都适用。

senses.def: used to ask sb to wait, or not to move

ex.en: Hold it a second—I don't think everyone's arrived yet.
ex.cn: 请稍候，我想人还没有到齐。

senses.def: a person cannot be prevented from doing sth

ex.en: Once she gets on to the subject of politics there's no holding her.
ex.cn: 她一谈起政治就滔滔不绝。

senses.def: to allow sth that sb has done to make you have a lower opinion of them
senses.chn: 因某人的所为而对其评价低

ex.en: I admit I made a mistake—but don't hold it against me.
ex.cn: 我承认我做错了，但别因此而看不起我。

senses.def: to prevent sb/sth from moving forward or crossing sth

ex.en: The police were unable to hold back the crowd.
ex.cn: 警察阻拦不住人群。

senses.def: to prevent the progress or development of sb/sth

ex.en: Do you think that mixed-ability classes hold back the better students?
ex.cn: 你认为把能力参差的学生混在一班会妨碍高水平学生进步吗？

senses.def: to not tell sb sth they want or need to know

ex.en: to hold back information
ex.cn: 隐瞒信息

senses.def: to stop yourself from expressing how you really feel
senses.chn: 抑制，控制（感情等）；不露声色

ex.en: She just managed to hold back her anger.
ex.cn: 她勉强压住了自己的怒火。

ex.en: He bravely held back his tears.
ex.cn: 他勇敢地没让眼泪流出来。

senses.def: to hesitate or to make sb hesitate to act or speak

ex.en: She held back, not knowing how to break the terrible news.
ex.cn: 她踌躇着，不知如何说出这一可怕的消息。

ex.en: I wanted to tell him the truth, but something held me back.
ex.cn: 我本想告诉他真实情况，但又开不了口。

senses.def: to prevent sb from moving, using force

ex.en: It took three men to hold him down.
ex.cn: 三个人才把他制伏了。

senses.def: to prevent sb from having their freedom or rights
senses.chn: 剥夺某人的自由（或权利）

ex.en: The people are held down by a repressive regime.
ex.cn: 人民受到了专制政权的压迫。

senses.def: to keep sth at a low level

ex.en: The rate of inflation must be held down.
ex.cn: 通货膨胀率必须控制在低水平。

senses.def: to keep a job for some time

ex.en: He was unable to hold down a job after his breakdown.
ex.cn: 他精神崩溃以后就没能保住工作。

senses.def: to limit sth, especially a noise

ex.en: Hold it down, will you? I'm trying to sleep!
ex.cn: 小点声行吗？我要睡觉！

senses.def: to speak for a long time about sth in a way that other people might find boring
to not express how you really feel

ex.en: to hold in your feelings/anger
ex.cn: 不流露感情；忍住怒火

senses.def: to not start

ex.en: The rain held off just long enough for us to have our picnic.
ex.cn: 雨还好，等到我们用完野餐才下起来。

senses.def: to not do sth immediately

ex.en: We could get a new computer now or hold off until prices are lower.
ex.cn: 我们现在就可以买新计算机，不然就等到降价再说。

ex.en: Could you hold off making your decision for a few days?
ex.cn: 你能推迟几天再作决定吗？

senses.def: to stop sb/sth defeating you

ex.en: She held off all the last-minute challengers and won the race in a new record time.
ex.cn: 她最后一刻甩掉了所有对手，以新的纪录赢得了赛跑冠军。

senses.def: used to tell sb to wait or stop

ex.en: Hold on a minute while I get my breath back.
ex.cn: 稍等一下，让我喘口气。

ex.en: Hold on! This isn't the right road.
ex.cn: 等一下！这条路不对。

senses.def: to survive in a difficult or dangerous situation
senses.chn: （在困境或危险中）坚持住，挺住

ex.en: They managed to hold on until help arrived.
ex.cn: 他们勉强坚持到救援到来。

senses.def: used on the telephone to ask sb to wait until they can talk to the person they want

ex.en: Can you hold on? I'll see if he's here.
ex.cn: 等一下行吗？我去看看他在不在。

senses.def: to keep sth in position

ex.en: These nuts and bolts hold the wheels on.
ex.cn: 这些螺母和螺栓把轮子固定住了。

ex.en: The knob is only held on by sticky tape.
ex.cn: 这个旋钮只是用胶带粘住的。

senses.def: to keep holding sth/sb

ex.en: Hold on and don't let go until I say so.
ex.cn: 握紧，等我让你松手时再松开。

ex.en: He held on to the back of the chair to stop himself from falling.
ex.cn: 他扶住椅子后背，以免摔倒。

ex.en: She was holding a large box.
ex.cn: 她提着一只大箱子。

ex.en: I held the baby gently in my arms.
ex.cn: 我把婴儿轻轻地抱在怀里。

ex.en: Hold on and don't let go until I say so.
ex.cn: 握紧，我让你松手时才松开。

ex.en: Survivors clung to pieces of floating debris.
ex.cn: 生还者紧紧抱住漂浮在水面上的残骸。

senses.def: to keep sth that is an advantage for you; to not give or sell sth to sb else
senses.chn: 保住（优势）；不送（或不卖）某物

ex.en: You should hold on to your oil shares.
ex.cn: 你应该继续保留住你的石油股份。

ex.en: She took an early lead in the race and held on to it for nine laps.
ex.cn: 赛跑一开始她便冲到了前面，并一直保持领先了九圈。

senses.def: to keep sth for sb else or for longer than usual
senses.chn: （替别人或更长时间地）保存某物

ex.en: I'll hold on to your mail for you until you get back.
ex.cn: 你回来之前我将一直替你保管邮件。

senses.def: to last, especially in a difficult situation

ex.en: We can stay here for as long as our supplies hold out.
ex.cn: 我们可以在这里一直待到我们的储备品用完。

senses.def: to resist or survive in a dangerous or difficult situation

ex.en: The rebels held out in the mountains for several years.
ex.cn: 反叛分子在山区顽抗了几年。

senses.def: to offer a chance, hope or possibility of sth
senses.chn: 提供机会；给予希望；使有可能

ex.en: Doctors hold out little hope of her recovering.
ex.cn: 医生对她的痊愈不抱很大的希望。

senses.def: to put your hand or arms, or sth in your hand, towards sb, especially to give or offer sth
senses.chn: 伸出手（或胳膊）；递出东西

ex.en: I held out my hand to steady her.
ex.cn: 我伸出手扶住她。

ex.en: He held out the keys and I took them.
ex.cn: 他伸手把钥匙递过来，我接了。

senses.def: to cause a delay in reaching an agreement because you hope you will gain sth

ex.en: The union negotiators are holding out for a more generous pay settlement.
ex.cn: 工会谈判代表拖延着，以期达成较优厚的薪酬协议。

senses.def: to refuse to tell or give sb sth
to not deal with sth immediately; to leave sth to be dealt with later

ex.en: The matter was held over until the next meeting.
ex.cn: 这件事被推迟到下次会议。

senses.def: to show a film/movie, play, etc. for longer than planned
senses.chn: 延长（电影、戏剧等）的上演期

ex.en: The movie proved so popular it was held over for another week.
ex.cn: 这部电影十分受欢迎，因此又继续上演了一周。

senses.def: to use knowledge that you have about sb to threaten them or make them do what you want
senses.chn: 以某事要挟（或威逼）某人

senses.def: to make sb keep a promise
to stop an opposing team scoring more points, etc. than you
senses.chn: 压住对方；不让对方（的得分等）超过己方

ex.en: The league leaders were held to a 0–0 draw.
ex.cn: 联赛积分领先的队伍被逼成了 0:0 的平局。

senses.def: to remain, or to keep sth, united

ex.en: A political party should hold together.
ex.cn: 一个政党应当团结一致。

ex.en: It's the mother who usually holds the family together.
ex.cn: 使全家人凝聚在一起的通常是母亲。

senses.def: to be logical or consistent

ex.en: Their case doesn't hold together when you look at the evidence.
ex.cn: 你看一下证据就知道他们的论点前后不一致。

senses.def: if a machine or an object holds together or sth holds it together, the different parts stay together so that it does not break
to remain strong and working effectively
senses.chn: 支持住；承受住；支撑得住

ex.en: She's holding up well under the pressure.
ex.cn: 她承受住了压力。

senses.def: to support sb/sth and stop them from falling
to delay or block the movement or progress of sb/sth

ex.en: An accident is holding up traffic.
ex.cn: 一场事故造成了交通阻塞。

ex.en: My application was held up by the postal strike.
ex.cn: 我的申请因邮政部门罢工而耽搁了。

senses.def: to use or present sb/sth as an example
senses.chn: 举出（例子）；提出（作为榜样）

ex.en: She's always holding up her children as models of good behaviour.
ex.cn: 她总是举例说自己的孩子表现如何好。

ex.en: His ideas were held up to ridicule.
ex.cn: 他的想法被当成了笑料。

senses.def: to steal from a bank, shop/store, etc. using a gun
to agree with sth

ex.en: I don't hold with the use of force.
ex.cn: 我不赞成使用武力。

ex.en: They don't hold with letting children watch as much TV as they want.
ex.cn: 他们不赞成让孩子随心所欲地看太多电视。

senses.def: the action of holding sb/sth; the way you are holding sb/sth

ex.en: His hold on her arm tightened.
ex.cn: 他把她的胳膊抓得更紧了。

ex.en: She tried to keep hold of the child's hand.
ex.cn: 她尽力拉住那孩子的手不放。

ex.en: Make sure you've got a steady hold on the camera.
ex.cn: 一定要拿稳相机。

senses.def: a particular way of holding sb, especially in a sport such as wrestling or in a fight
senses.chn: 持；握；抓；抱；（尤指摔跤、打斗中的）擒拿法

ex.en: The wrestler put his opponent into a head hold.
ex.cn: 那位摔跤手给对手来了个头部擒拿。

senses.def: influence, power or control over sb/sth

ex.en: What she knew about his past gave her a hold over him.
ex.cn: 她知道他的过去，所以能够控制他。

ex.en: He struggled to get a hold of his anger.
ex.cn: 他竭力压制自己的怒火。

senses.def: a place where you can put your hands or feet when climbing
senses.chn: 支撑点（可手攀或脚踏的地方）

senses.def: the part of a ship or plane where the goods being carried are stored
to have or take sb/sth in your hands

ex.en: He caught hold of her wrists so she couldn't get away.
ex.cn: 他抓住她的手腕，使她无法挣脱。

ex.en: Lee got hold of the dog by its collar.
ex.cn: 李拉住了狗的项圈。

ex.en: Quick, grab a hold of that rope.
ex.cn: 快，抓住那条绳子。

ex.en: Gently, she took hold of the door handle and turned it.
ex.cn: 她轻轻地握住门把手扭动了它。

senses.def: to contact or find sb

ex.en: Where have you been? I've been trying to get hold of you all day.
ex.cn: 你去哪了？我一整天都在找你。

senses.def: to find sth that you want or need

ex.en: I need to get hold of Tom's address.
ex.cn: 我需要找到汤姆的地址。

ex.en: It's almost impossible to get hold of tickets for the final.
ex.cn: 几乎不可能搞到决赛的门票。

senses.def: to learn or understand sth
with no rules or limits on what sb is allowed to do
delayed until a later time or date

ex.en: She put her career on hold to have a baby.
ex.cn: 她中断了事业以便生孩子。

ex.en: The project is on hold until more money is available.
ex.cn: 这项工程暂停，等到有更多的资金时再进行。

senses.def: if a person on the telephone is put on hold, they have to wait until the person that they want to talk to is free
to begin to have complete control over sb/sth; to become very strong
senses.chn: 开始完全控制；变得十分强大

ex.en: Panic took hold of him and he couldn't move.
ex.cn: 他突然惊慌得动弹不得。

ex.en: They got out of the house just before the flames took hold.
ex.cn: 他们就在大火吞噬房子之前逃了出来。

ex.en: It is best to treat the disease early before it takes a hold.
ex.cn: 最好还是病向浅中医。

senses.def: to understand sth in the wrong way

example.en: Hold your head up.
example.cn: 抬起头来。

example.en: I'll hold the door open for you.
example.cn: 我会把门给你开着的。

example.en: Police are holding two men in connection with last Thursday's bank raid.
example.cn: 警方拘留了两名与上星期四的银行抢劫案有关的男子。

example.en: He was held prisoner for two years.
example.cn: 他被囚禁了两年。

example.en: She is held in high regard by her students (= they have a high opinion of her).
example.cn: 学生对她评价很高。

example.en: I still hold that the government's economic policies are mistaken.
example.cn: 我仍然认为政府的经济政策是错误的。

example.en: Parents will be held responsible for their children's behaviour.
example.cn: 父母将要对孩子的行为负责。

example.en: These vases are held to be the finest examples of Greek art.
example.cn: 这些花瓶被视为希腊艺术的最佳典范。

example.en: She asked me to hold the line.
example.cn: 她要我别挂断电话。

example.en: Could you hold off making your decision for a few days?
example.cn: 你能推迟几天再作决定吗？

example.en: They don't hold with letting children watch as much TV as they want.
example.cn: 他们不赞成让孩子随心所欲地看太多电视。

senses.def: a large bag made of strong cloth or soft leather, used when you are travelling for carrying clothes, etc.
senses.chn: 大旅行袋（用帆布或软皮制造）

senses.def: to have all the advantages in a situation
to be able to control a particular situation because you have an advantage over other people
senses.chn: 能控制局势；应付自如；占上风

senses.def: a person who has or owns the thing mentioned

ex.en: a licence holder
ex.cn: 执照持有人

ex.en: a season ticket holder
ex.cn: 有季票的人

ex.en: the current holder of the world record
ex.cn: 目前的世界纪录保持者

ex.en: holders of high office
ex.cn: 高级官员

ex.en: the holder of a French passport
ex.cn: 持有法国护照者

senses.def: a thing that holds the object mentioned

ex.en: a pen holder
ex.cn: 笔筒

senses.def: to continue to believe in an idea, etc. despite difficulties
to speak for a long time about sth in a way that other people might find boring
to be true

ex.en: The same argument does not hold good in every case.
ex.cn: 同样的论点并非在所有的情况下都适用。

senses.def: a number of shares that sb has in a company

ex.en: She has a 40% holding in the company.
ex.cn: 她持有公司 40% 的股份。

senses.def: an amount of property that is owned by a person, museum, library, etc.
senses.chn: 私有财产；（博物馆、图书馆等的）馆藏

ex.en: one of the most important private holdings of Indian art
ex.cn: 印度艺术最重要的私人馆藏之一

senses.def: a piece of land that is rented by sb and used for farming
a company that is formed to buy shares in other companies which it then controls
a course of action that is taken so that a particular situation stays the same or does not become any worse
senses.chn: 维持现状的行动；使局势不致恶化的做法

senses.def: the route that a plane travels while it is flying above an airport waiting for permission to land
senses.chn: 等待航线（飞机在机场上空待降时的飞行路线）

senses.def: used to ask sb to wait, or not to move

ex.en: Hold it a second—I don't think everyone's arrived yet.
ex.cn: 请稍候，我想人还没有到齐。

senses.def: to not start

ex.en: The rain held off just long enough for us to have our picnic.
