ex.cn: 她以为她生命的最后时刻到了。

ex.en: Don't desert me in my hour of need.
ex.cn: 不要在我困难的时候离开我。

senses.def: the time when it is exactly 1 o'clock, 2 o'clock, etc.

ex.en: There's a bus every hour on the hour.
ex.cn: 每小时整点有一班公共汽车。

ex.en: The clock struck the hour.
ex.cn: 钟敲过整点了。

senses.def: used when giving the time according to the 24-hour clock, usually in military or other official language
senses.chn: （按 24 小时制给出的时间，通常用于军事或其他官方用语）点钟

ex.en: The first missile was launched at 2300 hours (= at 11 p.m.).
ex.cn: 首枚导弹是在 23 点（晚上 11 点）发射的。

senses.def: any time, especially a time which is not usual or suitable
senses.chn: 任何时间（尤指非正常或不合适的时间）

ex.en: He's started staying out till all hours (= until very late at night).
ex.cn: 他已经开始在外面待得很晚了。

ex.en: She thinks she can call me at all hours of the day and night.
ex.cn: 她以为她可以不分昼夜随时给我打电话。

senses.def: if you keep regular, strange, etc. hours, the times at which you do things (especially getting up or going to bed) are regular, strange, etc.
senses.chn: 做事（尤指作息）时间有规律（或怪异等）

senses.def: the period of time very early in the morning, soon after midnight
senses.chn: 午夜刚过的一段时间；凌晨时分

ex.en: We worked well into the small hours.
ex.cn: 我们一直工作到了午夜之后。

ex.en: The fighting began in the early hours of Saturday morning.
ex.cn: 战斗在星期六凌晨打响了。

senses.def: at the last possible moment; just in time
senses.chn: 在最后时刻；刚好来得及

senses.def: the time when you have to do sth difficult or unpleasant
senses.chn: 倒霉的时候（或日子、时刻）

senses.def: to spend time doing sth that is not important while you are waiting for sth else to happen

ex.en: We killed time playing cards.
ex.cn: 我们打纸牌消磨时间。

senses.def: very early, especially when this is annoying

ex.en: The job involved getting up at some unearthly hour to catch the first train.
ex.cn: 这工作需要起大早赶头班火车。

senses.def: very early or very late and therefore annoying
senses.chn: 一大早（或很晚）；在十分不便的时间

senses.def: a glass container holding sand that takes exactly an hour to pass through a small opening between the top and bottom sections
senses.chn: 沙漏（玻璃容器上部的沙子经一小孔漏到下部，全部漏完正好一小时）

senses.def: a woman who has an hourglass figure, shape, etc. has large breasts and hips and a small waist
senses.chn: （女人身材）丰乳肥臀的，上凸下翘的

senses.def: the small hand on a clock or watch that points to the hour
done or happening every hour

ex.en: an hourly bus service
ex.cn: 每小时一班的公共汽车

ex.en: Trains leave at hourly intervals.
ex.cn: 火车每隔一小时发出一列。

senses.def: an hourly wage, fee, rate, etc. is the amount that you earn every hour or pay for a service every hour
senses.chn: （工资、酬金、费用等）按钟点计算的，论小时的

ex.en: an hourly rate of $30 an hour
ex.cn: 每小时 30 美元的收费

senses.def: every hour

ex.en: Reapply sunscreen hourly and after swimming.
ex.cn: 每小时以及游泳后重新抹一次防晒霜。

ex.en: Dressings are changed four hourly (= every four hours) to help prevent infection.
ex.cn: 每四小时更换一次敷料，以防感染。

senses.def: a building for people to live in, usually for one family

ex.en: He went into the house.
ex.cn: 他进了房子。

ex.en: a two-bedroom house
ex.cn: 两居室的住宅

ex.en: Let's have the party at my house.
ex.cn: 我们在我家里聚会吧。

ex.en: house prices
ex.cn: 房价

ex.en: What time do you leave the house in the morning (= to go to work)?
ex.cn: 你早晨几点出门（去上班）？

ex.en: We're moving house (= leaving our house and going to live in a different one).
ex.cn: 我们要搬家了。

senses.def: all the people living in a house
senses.chn: 住在一所房子里的人；全家人

ex.en: Be quiet or you'll wake the whole house!
ex.cn: 安静点，别把全家人都吵醒！

senses.def: a building used for a particular purpose, for example for holding meetings in or keeping animals or goods in

ex.en: an opera house
ex.cn: 歌剧院

ex.en: a henhouse
ex.cn: 鸡舍

senses.def: used in the names of office buildings

ex.en: Their offices are on the second floor of Chester House.
ex.cn: 他们的办公室在切斯特大厦三楼。

senses.def: a company involved in a particular kind of business; an institution of a particular kind

ex.en: a fashion/banking/publishing, etc. house
ex.cn: 时装公司、银行、出版社等

ex.en: a religious house (= a convent or a monastery )
ex.cn: 宗教会所

ex.en: I work in house (= in the offices of the company that I work for, not at home).
ex.cn: 我在公司里上班。

senses.def: a restaurant

ex.en: a steakhouse
ex.cn: 牛排餐馆

ex.en: a coffee house
ex.cn: 咖啡馆

ex.en: a bottle of house wine (= the cheapest wine available in a particular restaurant, sometimes not listed by name)
ex.cn: 一瓶本店特价酒

senses.def: a group of people who meet to discuss and make the laws of a country

ex.en: Legislation requires approval by both houses of parliament.
ex.cn: 立法须要得到议会两院的一致通过。

senses.def: the House of Commons or the House of Lords in Britain; the House of Representatives in the US
senses.chn: （英国）下议院，上议院；（美国）众议院

senses.def: a group of people discussing sth in a formal debate

ex.en: I urge the house to vote against the motion.
ex.cn: 我呼吁参加辩论的诸位投票反对这项动议。

senses.def: the part of a theatre where the audience sits; the audience at a particular performance

ex.en: playing to a full/packed/empty house (= to a large/small audience)
ex.cn: 演出座无虚席／满座／观众寥寥无几

ex.en: The spotlight faded and the house lights came up.
ex.cn: 聚光灯渐渐熄灭，观众席的灯亮了。

senses.def: (in some British schools) an organized group of students of different ages who compete against other groups in sports competitions, etc. and who may, in boarding schools, live together in one building
senses.chn: （英国某些学校为进行体育比赛或按宿舍将学生分成的）社，舍

senses.def: an old and famous family

ex.en: the House of Windsor (= the British royal family)
ex.cn: 温莎王室

senses.def: to make everyone laugh or cheer, especially at a performance in the theatre
senses.chn: （尤指剧院的演出）博得满堂大笑（或喝彩）

senses.def: to become friends quickly and have a very friendly relationship
senses.chn: 很快就打得火热；一见如故；一拍即合

senses.def: to do sth or ask a question in a very complicated way instead of in a simple, direct way
senses.chn: 绕圈子；拐弯抹角；不直截了当

senses.def: to cook, clean and do all the other jobs around the house
drinks or meals that are on the house are provided free by the pub/bar or restaurant and you do not have to pay
to organize your own business or improve your own behaviour before you try to criticize sb else
senses.chn: 先管好自己的事；律人先律己

senses.def: to make a place your home

ex.en: They set up house together in a small flat in Brighton.
ex.cn: 他们一同在布赖顿的一个小公寓里建立了家庭。

senses.def: to remove people or things that are not necessary or wanted
senses.chn: 清除不必要的人（或事物）；裁减

ex.en: The new manager said he wanted to clean house.
ex.cn: 新上任的经理说他要裁员。

senses.def: to make your house clean
used to say that everyone was very emotional about sth
senses.chn: 全场无人不流泪；全场无不为之动容

ex.en: There wasn't a dry eye in the house when they announced their engagement.
ex.cn: 他们宣布订婚时大伙眼睛全湿了。

senses.def: to eat a lot of sb else's food
you should not criticize other people, because they will easily find ways of criticizing you
senses.chn: 身居玻璃房，投石招祸殃；自身毛病多，勿挑他人错

senses.def: very safe
to provide a place for sb to live

ex.en: The government is committed to housing the refugees.
ex.cn: 政府承诺收容难民。

senses.def: to be the place where sth is kept or where sth operates from
senses.chn: 是（某物）的贮藏处（或安置处）；收藏；安置

ex.en: The gallery houses 2 000 works of modern art.
ex.cn: 美术馆收藏了 2 000 件现代艺术作品。

ex.en: The museum is housed in the Old Court House.
ex.cn: 博物馆设在旧法院大楼里。

senses.def: the state of being a prisoner in your own house rather than in a prison

ex.en: to be under house arrest
ex.cn: 遭到软禁

ex.en: She was placed under house arrest.
ex.cn: 她遭到了软禁。

senses.def: a boat that people can live in, usually kept at a particular place on a river or canal
unable to leave your house because you cannot walk very far as a result of being ill/sick or old
senses.chn: （因病或年迈）不能离家的，出不了门的

senses.def: people who are housebound
a young male servant in a house
the crime of entering a house illegally by using force, in order to steal things from it
trained to defecate and urinate outside the house or in a special box
senses.chn: 经训练在户外（或专用盒子里）便溺的

senses.def: a long loose piece of clothing, worn in the house by women
a common fly that lives in houses
a large number of people in a house

ex.en: He grew up in a houseful of women.
ex.cn: 他在一个满是女人的家庭里长大。

ex.en: They had a houseful so we didn't stay.
ex.cn: 他们满屋子都是人，所以我们没有留下来。

senses.def: a person who is staying in your house for a short time
all the people living together in a house or flat/apartment
senses.chn: 一家人；家庭；同住一所（或一套）房子的人

ex.en: Most households now own at least one car.
ex.cn: 大多数家庭现在至少有一辆汽车。

ex.en: low-income/one-parent, etc. households
ex.cn: 低收入、单亲等家庭

ex.en: the head of the household
ex.cn: 户主

senses.def: a person who owns or rents the house that they live in
a name that has become very well known

ex.en: She became a household name in the 1960s.
ex.cn: 她在 20 世纪 60 年代成为家喻户晓的人物。

senses.def: the activity of looking for a house to buy
senses.chn: 找房子，看房子（以便购买）

senses.def: a man who stays at home to cook, clean, take care of the children, etc. while his wife or partner goes out to work
senses.chn: 操持家务的丈夫；“家庭主夫”

senses.def: a person, usually a woman, whose job is to manage the shopping, cooking, cleaning, etc. in a house or an institution
senses.chn: 管家，杂务主管（通常为女性）

senses.def: a person whose job is to manage the cleaning of rooms in a hotel
the work involved in taking care of a house, especially shopping and managing money
senses.chn: 家务（尤指采购和管理开支）

senses.def: the department in a hotel, a hospital, an office building, etc. that is responsible for cleaning the rooms, etc.
senses.chn: （旅馆、医院、写字楼等的）总务处，后勤部

ex.en: Call housekeeping and ask them to bring us some clean towels.
ex.cn: 给总务处打电话，让他们给我们送些干净的毛巾来。

senses.def: the money used to buy food, cleaning materials and other things needed for taking care of a house
jobs that are done to enable an organization or computer system to work well

ex.en: Most large companies now use computers for accounting and housekeeping operations.
ex.cn: 多数大公司现在用计算机进行会计运算和内务操作。

senses.def: a female servant in a large house who cleans the rooms, etc. and often lives there
a man employed to do general jobs in a house, hotel, etc.
senses.chn: （家庭或旅馆等的）男勤杂工，男仆

senses.def: a small black and white European bird like a swallow
a teacher in charge of a group of children (called a house) in a school, especially a private school
a person that you share a house with, but who is not one of your family
senses.chn: 同屋（指同住一所房子但非家庭成员的人）

senses.def: a teacher in charge of a group of children (called a house) in a school, especially a private school
a type of electronic dance music with a fast beat
senses.chn: 货仓音乐，浩室音乐（一种快节奏电子舞曲）

senses.def: a plan, an organization, etc. that is so badly arranged that it could easily fail
senses.chn: 不可靠的计划；摇摇欲坠的组织

senses.def: a structure built out of playing cards
(in Britain) a doctor who has finished medical school and who is working at a hospital to get further practical experience
a church or other religious building
a party held at a large house in the country where guests stay for a few days; the guests at this party
senses.chn: 乡村府邸聚会，乡村府邸聚会的全体宾客（常留宿几天）

senses.def: a plant that you grow in a pot and keep indoors
spending a lot of time making your house look clean and attractive, and thinking that this is important
space in a house for sb/sth
senses.chn: 家里的容纳空间；家里放东西的地方

senses.def: to not like sth and not want it in your house
senses.chn: 不喜欢把某物放在家里

senses.def: to live in sb's house while they are away in order to take care of it for them
a common small grey and brown bird that lives in the roofs of houses
the way a company such as a publisher prefers its written materials to be expressed and arranged
senses.chn: （出版社等书面材料的）特有样式，特有风格

senses.def: visiting every house in a particular area

ex.en: a house-to-house collection/search
ex.cn: 挨家收集／搜查

ex.en: The police are making house-to-house enquiries.
ex.cn: 警察正在逐户调查。

senses.def: trained to defecate and urinate outside the house or in a special box
senses.chn: 经训练在户外（或专用盒子里）便溺的

senses.def: small items used in the house, especially kitchen equipment
senses.chn: 家用器皿；（尤指）厨房用具

senses.def: a party given by sb who has just moved into a new house
a woman who stays at home to cook, clean, take care of the children, etc. while her husband or partner goes out to work
the work involved in taking care of a home and family, for example cleaning and cooking

ex.en: to do the housework
ex.cn: 做家务

senses.def: houses, flats/apartments, etc. that people live in, especially when referring to their type, price or condition
senses.chn: （统称，尤指住房类型、价格、条件）住房，住宅

ex.en: public/private housing
ex.cn: 公共／私人住房

ex.en: poor housing conditions
ex.cn: 恶劣的居住条件

ex.en: the housing shortage
ex.cn: 住房短缺

ex.en: the housing market (= the activity of buying and selling houses, etc.)
ex.cn: 住房市场

senses.def: the job of providing houses, flats/apartments, etc. for people to live in

ex.en: the housing department
ex.cn: 住房建设部门

ex.en: the council's housing policy
ex.cn: 市政住房政策

senses.def: a hard cover that protects part of a machine

ex.en: a car's rear axle housing
ex.cn: 汽车的后轴套

senses.def: (in Britain) an organization that owns houses, flats/apartments, etc. and helps people to rent or buy them at a low price
senses.chn: （英国）房屋协会（以低价出租或出售房屋）

senses.def: (in Britain) money given by the government to people who do not earn much, to help them pay for a place to live in
an area in which a large number of houses or flats/apartments are planned and built together at the same time

ex.en: They live on a housing estate.
ex.cn: 他们住在一个住宅区里。

senses.def: a group of houses or flats/apartments built for poor families, usually with government money
senses.chn: 公房项目；公房区（常由政府为贫困家庭建造）

senses.def: the largest city in Texas and the fourth largest city in the United States
senses.chn: 休斯敦（美国第四大城市，得克萨斯州最大城市）

senses.def: a house or room that is not fit to live in because it is dirty or in very bad condition
senses.chn: （不适于居住的）肮脏简陋的住所

senses.def: to stay in the air in one place

ex.en: A hawk hovered over the hill.
ex.cn: 一只鹰在小山的上空翱翔。

senses.def: to wait somewhere, especially near sb, in a shy or uncertain manner
senses.chn: 踌躇，彷徨（尤指在某人身边）

ex.en: He hovered nervously in the doorway.
ex.cn: 他在门口紧张地来回踱步。

senses.def: to stay close to sth, or to stay in an uncertain state
senses.chn: 靠近（某事物）；处于不稳定状态

ex.en: Temperatures hovered around freezing.
ex.cn: 气温在冰点上下徘徊。

ex.en: He hovered on the edge of consciousness.
ex.cn: 他似醒非醒。

ex.en: A smile hovered on her lips.
ex.cn: 她的嘴上挂着一丝笑容。

senses.def: a vehicle that travels just above the surface of water or land, held up by air being forced downwards
high-occupancy vehicle lane (a part of the road that may only be used by vehicles that are carrying two or more people)
senses.chn: 多乘员车辆车道（仅供搭载两人及以上的车辆通行）

senses.def: in what way or manner

ex.en: How does it work?
ex.cn: 它是如何运作的？

ex.en: He did not know how he ought to behave.
ex.cn: 他不知道自己应该怎样表现。

ex.en: I'll show you how to load the software.
ex.cn: 我给你演示一下如何安装这套软件。

ex.en: 'Her behaviour was very odd.' ' How so? '
ex.cn: “她的举止非常奇怪。” “怎么会这样呢？”

ex.en: It's funny how (= that) people always remember him.
ex.cn: 有趣的是人们总是忘不了他。

ex.en: Do you remember how (= that) the kids always loved going there?
ex.cn: 你记得孩子们总喜欢去那里吗？

senses.def: used to ask about sb's health

ex.en: How are you?
ex.cn: 你（身体）好吗？

ex.en: How are you feeling now?
ex.cn: 你现在感觉怎么样？

senses.def: used to ask whether sth is successful or enjoyable

ex.en: How was your trip?
ex.cn: 你旅行愉快吗？

ex.en: How did they play?
ex.cn: 他们的比赛表现怎样？

senses.def: used before an adjective or adverb to ask about the amount, degree, etc. of sth, or about sb's age
senses.chn: （后接形容词或副词）多少，多么，多大

ex.en: How often do you go swimming?
ex.cn: 你多久去游一次泳？

ex.en: I didn't know how much to bring.
ex.cn: 我不知道该带多少。

ex.en: How much are those earrings (= What do they cost)?
ex.cn: 那对耳环多少钱？

ex.en: How many people were there?
ex.cn: 有多少人？

ex.en: How old is she?
ex.cn: 她有多大了？

senses.def: used to express surprise, pleasure, etc.

ex.en: How kind of you to help!
ex.cn: 你来帮忙，真是太好了！

ex.en: How he wished he had been there!
ex.cn: 他多么希望当时自己也在场！

senses.def: in any way in which
senses.chn: 以任何方式；无论用什么方法

ex.en: I'll dress how I like in my own house!
ex.cn: 我在自己家里爱怎么穿就怎么穿！

senses.def: used when asking for information about sb/sth

ex.en: I'm not going. How about you?
ex.cn: 我不打算去。你呢？

senses.def: used to make a suggestion
senses.chn: （提出建议）…怎么样，…行不行，…好吗

ex.en: How about a break?
ex.cn: 休息一下好吗？

ex.en: How about going for a meal?
ex.cn: 去吃饭好不好？

ex.en: How about we go for a meal?
ex.cn: 我们去吃饭好不好？

senses.def: used to show that you strongly disapprove of sb's behaviour or are very surprised by it
senses.chn: （表示很不赞同或吃惊）你怎么能

ex.en: Ben! How could you? After all they've done for us!
ex.cn: 本！他们为我们做了这么多，你怎么能这样！

ex.en: Ugh! How can you eat that stuff?
ex.cn: 啊！你怎么吃得下那种东西？

senses.def: used as a formal greeting when you meet sb for the first time. The usual reply is also How do you do?
senses.chn: （首次见面时的问候语。通常的回答也是 How do you do?）你好

senses.def: used to ask the reason for sth

ex.en: 'I left work early today.' 'How's that (= Why)?'
ex.cn: “我今天提前下班了。” “为什么？”

senses.def: used when asking sb's opinion of sth

ex.en: I'll tuck your sheets in for you. How's that? Comfortable?
ex.cn: 我给你把被单掖好吧。怎么样？舒服吗？

ex.en: Two o'clock on the dot! How's that for punctuality!
ex.cn: 两点整！够守时吧！

senses.def: used to say you do not understand how sth can happen and would like an explanation
senses.chn: （用以表示不理解情况是如何发生的，希望得到解释）怎么回事，怎么发生的，怎样解释

ex.en: 'I think you owe me some money.' 'How come?'
ex.cn: “你好像欠我钱。” “怎么会呢？”

ex.en: If she spent five years in Paris, how come her French is so bad?
ex.cn: 既然她在巴黎待了五年，她的法语怎么还会这样糟糕？

senses.def: a seat for riding on the back of an elephant or a camel , often for more than one person
senses.chn: 象轿，驼轿（大象或骆驼背上的鞍座，常常可坐不只一人）

senses.def: used as a formal greeting when you meet sb for the first time. The usual reply is also How do you do?
senses.chn: （首次见面时的问候语。通常的回答也是 How do you do?）你好

senses.def: used to say hello

ex.en: Howdy, partner.
ex.cn: 你好，伙计。

senses.def: used with an adjective or adverb to mean 'to whatever degree'
senses.chn: （与形容词或副词连用）无论到什么程度，不管多么

senses.def: the practice of keeping yourself and your living and working areas clean in order to prevent illness and disease

ex.en: food hygiene
ex.cn: 食物卫生

ex.en: personal hygiene
ex.cn: 个人卫生

ex.en: In the interests of hygiene, please wash your hands.
ex.cn: 为了卫生，请洗手。

senses.def: clean and free of bacteria and therefore unlikely to spread disease

ex.en: Food must be prepared in hygienic conditions.
ex.cn: 食物必须在卫生的环境中制作。

senses.def: a person who works with a dentist and whose job is to clean people's teeth and give them advice about keeping them clean
senses.chn: 牙科保健员；牙科洁治员

senses.def: a piece of skin that partly covers the opening of the vagina in women who have never had sex
a song of praise, especially one praising God and sung by Christians
senses.chn: 赞美诗，圣歌（尤指基督徒唱的颂扬上帝的歌）

senses.def: if a film/movie, book, etc. is a hymn to sth, it praises it very strongly
senses.chn: 歌颂某事物的电影（或书等）

senses.def: to show that you are in agreement with each other by saying the same things in public
senses.chn: 唱同一调子（在公开场合口径一致）

senses.def: a book of hymns
advertisements and discussion on television, radio, etc. telling the public about a product and about how good or important it is
senses.chn: （电视、广播等中言过其实的）促销广告，促销讨论

ex.en: marketing/media hype
ex.cn: 夸张的促销／媒体广告

ex.en: Don't believe all the hype—the book isn't that good.
ex.cn: 别相信那些天花乱坠的宣传，那本书没那么好。

senses.def: to advertise sth a lot and exaggerate its good qualities, in order to get a lot of public attention for it

ex.en: This week his much hyped new movie opens in London.
ex.cn: 本周他那部被大肆炒作的新电影在伦敦上映。

ex.en: The meeting was hyped up in the media as an important event.
ex.cn: 这次会议被媒体吹成一件大事。

senses.def: very worried or excited about sth that is going to happen
senses.chn: 十分担忧的；很激动的；十分兴奋的

senses.def: excited and nervous; having too much nervous energy
senses.chn: 既兴奋又紧张的；精力过旺的

senses.def: more than normal; too much

ex.en: hypercritical
ex.cn: 批评苛刻的

ex.en: hypertension
ex.cn: 高血压

senses.def: too active and only able to keep quiet and still for short periods
at a higher pressure than normal
a symmetrical open curve
a way of speaking or writing that makes sth sound better, more exciting, more dangerous, etc. than it really is
of or related to a hyperbola
deliberately exaggerated; using hyperbole

the condition of having too high a level of blood sugar
a situation in which prices rise very fast, causing damage to a country's economy
senses.chn: 恶性通货膨胀；超通货膨胀；过度通货膨胀

senses.def: a very large shop located outside a town, that sells a wide range of goods
senses.chn: 特大型商店（坐落在城外，商品种类繁多）

senses.def: a system that links text to files containing images, sound or video
senses.chn: 超媒体（连接文本与图像、声音或影像文件的系统）

senses.def: very easily offended
senses.chn: 非常敏感的；很容易生气的

ex.en: He's hypersensitive to any kind of criticism.
ex.cn: 他对任何批评都受不了。

senses.def: extremely physically sensitive to particular substances, medicines, light, etc.
senses.chn: （对某些物质、药物、光等）过敏的

ex.en: Her skin is hypersensitive.
ex.cn: 她的皮肤过敏。

senses.def: space which consists of more than three dimensions
a situation in which it is possible to travel faster than light
blood pressure that is higher than is normal
text stored in a computer system that contains links that allow the user to move from one piece of text or document to another
a condition in which the thyroid is too active, making the heart and other body systems function too quickly
an increase in the size of an organ or tissue because its cells grow in size
senses.chn: （器官或组织的）肥大，过度生长

senses.def: to breathe too quickly because you are very frightened or excited
the mark ( - ) used to join two words together to make a new one, as in back-up, or to show that a word has been divided between the end of one line and the beginning of the next
to join two words together using a hyphen; to divide a word between two lines of text using a hyphen
senses.chn: 用连字符连接；用连字符分割（词语）

ex.en: Is your name hyphenated?
ex.cn: 你的名字有用连字符吗？

senses.def: an unconscious state in which sb can still see and hear and can be influenced to follow commands or answer questions

ex.en: She only remembered details of the accident under hypnosis.
ex.cn: 她只有在催眠状态下才能记起那次事故的细节。

senses.def: a kind of treatment that uses hypnosis to help with physical or emotional problems
making you feel as if you are going to fall asleep, especially because of a regular, repeated noise or movement
senses.chn: 有催眠作用的；使人昏昏欲睡的

ex.en: hypnotic music
ex.cn: 引人昏昏欲睡的音乐

ex.en: His voice had an almost hypnotic effect.
ex.cn: 他的声音有一种近乎催眠的作用。

senses.def: connected with or produced by hypnosis
senses.chn: 催眠状态的；催眠状态引起的

ex.en: a hypnotic trance/state
ex.cn: 催眠迷睡／状态

senses.def: making you sleep
a drug that makes you sleep; a sleeping pill
the practice of hypnotizing a person (= putting them into an unconscious state)
a person who hypnotizes people
to produce a state of hypnosis in sb
to interest sb so much that they can think of nothing else
under; below normal

ex.cn: 皮下注射的

ex.en: hypothermia

senses.def: hypoallergenic substances and materials are unlikely to cause an allergic reaction in the person who uses them
senses.chn: 不致过敏的；低变敏原的

senses.def: a state in which sb worries all the time about their health and believes that they are ill/sick when there is nothing wrong with them

ex.en: Don't be such a hypochondriac!—there's nothing wrong with you.
ex.cn: 别这么忧心忡忡的了！你根本没病。

senses.def: behaviour in which sb pretends to have moral standards or opinions that they do not actually have

ex.en: He condemned the hypocrisy of those politicians who do one thing and say another.
ex.cn: 他谴责了那些说一套做一套的政客的虚伪。

senses.def: a person who pretends to have moral standards or opinions that they do not actually have
senses.chn: 伪君子；伪善者；虚伪的人

senses.def: a medical instrument with a long thin needle that is used to give sb an injection under their skin
the condition of having too low a level of blood sugar
a word with a particular meaning that is included in the meaning of a more general word, for example 'dog' and 'cat' are hyponyms of 'animal'
senses.chn: 下义词，下位词（如 dog 和 cat 是 animal 的下义词）

senses.def: the use of subordinate clauses
senses.chn: 从句的使用；从属关系；主从结构

senses.def: the side opposite the right angle of a right-angled triangle

senses.chn: 下丘脑（有调节体温、摄食、内分泌等的功能）

senses.def: a medical condition in which the body temperature is much lower than normal

senses.chn: （有少量事实依据但未被证实的）假说，假设

ex.en: to formulate/confirm a hypothesis
ex.cn: 提出／证实假设

ex.en: a hypothesis about the function of dreams
ex.cn: 关于梦的作用的假说

senses.def: guesses and ideas that are not based on certain knowledge

ex.en: It would be pointless to engage in hypothesis before we have the facts.
ex.cn: 在我们还没掌握事实之前瞎猜是毫无意义的。

senses.def: to suggest a way of explaining sth when you do not definitely know about it; to form a hypothesis

ex.en: The causes can be hypothesized but not proved.
ex.cn: 原因能够被假定，但不能被证实。

ex.en: We can only hypothesize that the cases we know about are typical.
ex.cn: 我们只能假设我们知道的案例是典型的。

senses.def: based on situations or ideas which are possible and imagined rather than real and true

ex.en: a hypothetical question/situation/example
ex.cn: 假定的问题／情况／例子

ex.en: Let us take the hypothetical case of Sheila, a mother of two…
ex.cn: 我们且举关于希拉这个假定的例子，她是一位有两个孩子的母亲…

ex.en: I wasn't asking about anybody in particular—it was a purely hypothetical question.
ex.cn: 我并没有问到具体某个人，那不过是个纯粹假设性的问题。

senses.def: a condition in which the thyroid is not active enough, making growth and mental development slower than normal
a lower than normal amount of oxygen in the blood
a condition in which not enough oxygen reaches the body's tissues
a medical operation to remove a woman's womb
a state of extreme excitement, fear or anger in which a person, or a group of people, loses control of their emotions and starts to cry, laugh, etc.

ex.en: There was mass hysteria when the band came on stage.
ex.cn: 乐队登台时观众一片疯狂。

ex.en: A note of hysteria crept into her voice.
ex.cn: 她的声音听来有点歇斯底里。

senses.def: an extremely excited and exaggerated way of behaving or reacting to an event
senses.chn: 大肆鼓吹；狂热夸张；大惊小怪

ex.cn: 媒体对于王室成员访问的惯常的大肆渲染

ex.en: public hysteria about AIDS
ex.cn: 公众对艾滋病谈虎色变

senses.def: a condition in which sb experiences violent or extreme emotions that they cannot control, especially as a result of shock
in a state of extreme excitement, and crying, laughing, etc. in an uncontrolled way
senses.chn: 歇斯底里的；情绪狂暴不可抑止的

ex.en: hysterical screams
ex.cn: 歇斯底里的尖叫

ex.en: a hysterical giggle
ex.cn: 无法控制的傻笑

ex.en: He became almost hysterical when I told him.
ex.cn: 我告诉他时，他几乎要发疯了。

ex.en: Let's not get hysterical.
ex.cn: 咱们别太激动。

ex.en: He thought I was being a hysterical female.
ex.cn: 他觉得我当时像个歇斯底里的女人。

senses.def: extremely funny

ex.en: She seemed to find my situation absolutely hysterical.
ex.cn: 她好像觉得我的处境极端可笑。

senses.def: an expression of extreme fear, excitement or anger that makes sb lose control of their emotions and cry, laugh, etc.

ex.en: He went into hysterics when he heard the news.
ex.cn: 他听到这个消息时变得歇斯底里。

senses.def: wild laughter

ex.en: She had the audience in hysterics.
ex.cn: 她令观众捧腹大笑。

senses.def: to be extremely upset and angry

ex.en: My mum'll have hysterics when she sees the colour of my hair.
ex.cn: 我妈妈看到我的头发的颜色会火冒三丈的。
